name: Trisha Calvarese
subject: Here’s how we get Lauren Boebert out of office
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fight for Progress PAC and not authorized by any candidate or any candidate's committee
body:
I want to make sure that everyone has access to what I had – a union that has their back, Medicare and Medicaid when they need it, high quality and affordable healthcare.

| Hi Peter,

I’m Trisha Calvarese and I’m writing to you as the newly elected Democratic nominee, running against Lauren Boebert in CO-04.

I got into this race because just before he died last fall, my father – a staunch Republican – told me to get off the sidelines. He died shortly thereafter, within 13 days of my mom dying.

Today, I’m off the sidelines because of them. And because I was able to care for them in their final days, thanks to my union, the AFL-CIO. And because their union pensions and Medicare covered their healthcare costs, they didn’t die leaving behind hundreds of thousands of dollars of medical debt.

I want to make sure that everyone has access to what I had – a union that has their back, Medicare and Medicaid when they need it, high quality and affordable healthcare.

And I promise you this – I am going to fight for you just as hard as I did for my parents.

I know firsthand about the economic and care changes we all face, how critical the care and benefits promised to seniors are to families.

I’m running to stop Lauren Boebert from raising the retirement age or cutting Social Security and Medicare. We will honor veterans where Lauren Boebert let them down. We will restore and expand the reproductive care Lauren Boebert wants to deny.

I was raised in Sterling and Highlands Ranch. I’m proud to be a daughter of this district.

And you have confirmed the values that I was raised on right here in Douglas County: that working people can step up in the face of adversity and prevail, that we can choose hope over fear, community over division, and that together, we can save our democracy and defeat Lauren Boebert once and for all.

[_**If you are ready to join us today in this fight, can I count on you to split a contribution between my campaign and Fight for Progress?**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/88662576/484723192/1382461990?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-07-10_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNhMzg4YzE1LTE4M2YtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Nlb17m7vgfK8ubdA3deEjOqmJe2nrENkxBLTW2jPB7M=)

Thank you so much,

Trisha

| | Fellow Patriot, I remember it like it was yesterday. My father was working in West Africa, and we were living there when radical Iranians invaded the U.S. embassy in Tehran.

As a precaution, the U.S. Marines brought all U.S. citizens and green card holders to the U.S. Embassy. The look on their eyes said _“_ _Nothing will happen to you tonight. Not on my watch”_

In that moment, I knew I wanted to be JUST like them. **I wanted to grow up and defend the country that gave safe harbor to me and my family.**
Fast forward ten years, and I attended the U.S. Naval Academy and served for 25 years as a Navy Special Operations Officer, retiring as a Captain.

There is no honor like serving your country, and I’m ready for a new capacity of service: **representing the Commonwealth of Virginia in the U.S. Senate.**

**[Before I tell you a little bit about why I’m running, would you consider pitching in a few bucks to our campaign?](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=135900719ec74340934019b52448b45e&_e=vSgmxmoJdEqRhIqnbwNNa4dle8ZkT2fotgg0s64RQPXdm7TxHhYAv8XtQKnAAjifr_X4NlfLAN-yqQ55gdSl5gDWgrSN9yRD6vO07kyR5XPYuyeH40FPnuZwg_80mA6N1MOaxffR2io2pgzTZtr_Rdejt6mBqAOBoNQ1ZxcShjWRxwiYCwasv6fDnbGy1wu8OuZ4NnNS-xGU_3Y-QmVSYnGJRFRs4FMnvaVT5XnRANlGNgUaVdBC3LZcDB_tUu4x69D8j9HzK9fyE1MYKeNZUKciR4758g0XPbT8qxi3EUpGgpl8Vv3-QAhwep5q_OXBSzmF2KBZowEVuiu-fnJyMzNxnq7XG5yVwafX6N8DhE23K5man9PEP0wCoEPvBaof)**

You see, there’s a Latin saying we like to use in the Navy: **“ Non sibi sed patriae.” It means “not self but country,” and it’s a phrase that’s foreign to too many of today’s politicians. **

Politicians like Tim Kaine have completely lost touch with the American people. They’d rather keep our borders wide open to criminals than take care of our veterans and our law-abiding citizens. They’re more interested in keeping special, high-dollar interests happy than serving the people who elected them.

As someone who dedicated my life to fighting for our country, it makes me absolutely sick.

I risked my life to keep America safe, and now, politicians like Tim Kaine are throwing away all of our servicemembers’ hard work.

_I won’t sit back idly and let him do that without a fight._

According to famed UK veterinarian _Dr. Marc Abraham OBE: “The_ _ _ inability to leave the house is a common symptom of loneliness, so having to walk a dog once or twice daily encourages outside physical fitness, lowers rates of obesity and increases the frequency and likelihood of real life human-human interactions.” At our [PHS event](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=23371a12e4&e=c0babbc643), you will learn how you can adopt your forever furry friend including dogs, cats, small animals and even exotic animals such as lizards, snakes and turtles [https://phs-spca.org/adopt/exotic-animals/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=e3361d143c&e=c0babbc643). This event launches the first of many in my office’s “Loneliness t o Light Series.” Abraham continues on the Campaign to End Loneliness blog: “Indeed, having a dog by your side is often the ultimate conversation starter, igniting connections, thus reducing feelings of social isolation. I don't tell you this lightly and I know that's not what you want to see happen to our country.

_**[That's why I'm rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z2mse3qejn7quksiam0s38qjq1rp9e4o20i7rl2o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cdie4o32cjh2bs "That’s why I’m rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.")**_ I know what you're thinking... that's not enough runway to raise that much. subject: We have a problem. A big one.

body:
I briefed President Trump on America’s most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

| |

---
| | | I endured the gauntlet of West Point Military Academy, then boot camp, then became a Tank Platoon Leader in the final days of the Cold War.

I briefed President Trump on America's most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

And I stood eye-to-eye with the most dangerous dictators in the world as Trump's Secretary of State.

**It takes a lot to make me feel on edge. So the fact that I 'm even sending you this email should give you pause. **

Because I'm afraid we have a problem. A big one.

I just got word that Joe Biden and the Democrats are _closer than they 've ever been before_ to destroying our Conservative House Majority once and for all. The latest reports show they've stockpiled over $100,000,000 to defeat us in enough swing states to bring forth a COMPLETE LIBERAL TAKEOVER.

The ONLY THING standing in the way of Joe Biden having full control - and ramming through any radical policy he wants - is just a few competitive House seats. That's it.

I don't tell you this lightly and I know that's not what you want to see happen to our country.

_**[That's why I'm rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z2infc151ligvp75u26mdo6fg3l124np5gibdep0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cdie9oj2cph2bs "That’s why I’m rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.")**_ I know what you're thinking... that's not enough runway to raise that much. But desperate times call for desperate measures. And if that's what it'll take to win, I'm willing to chase down every lead.

If all you can spare is ten or twenty bucks, that would be incredible. If you can afford more that's even better. I only ask that everyone give something.

Will you do what it takes to hand Joe Biden and the Democrats a humiliating defeat?
---

I know this is a lofty goal. I know there's not much time to hit it. It would be much easier to call it a day and not even try.

**But just giving up plays right into their hands. **

_**[That's why I'm taking the time to send you this email. Our path to success fully relies on EVERYONE pitching in SOMETHING. That's how we'll catch up to the Democrats and win this election in a landslide.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zithvnmahjf282la01ti3t6laubu4fnrmo6c5168_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cdie9oj2cph2bs "That’s why I’m taking the time to send you this email. Our path to success fully relies on EVERYONE pitching in SOMETHING. That’s how we’ll catch up to the Democrats and win this election in a landslide.")**_

Frankly, that's the only way. So I really hope you can step up when we need you the most.

Thank you. God bless you.
Mike Pompeo

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: new GOP platform unveiled
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

Monday morning, I woke up to several texts from nearly a dozen GOP pro-life delegates.

They were worried that we were about to get steamrolled, as a new platform by was being crafted by the Trump Campaign and no one had seen yet, but the rumor was it was going to gut the GOP’s pro-life position.

After rushing to mobilize students and staff to get them to Milwaukee, everything came to a screeching halt early afternoon when we learned that the new platform plan had presented in a closed-room session, the RNC Platform Delegates were told there would be no debate on it at all _(even though it’s usually a multi-day process),_ and a vote was called forcing RNC Delegates to approve it.

In the end, the Trump campaign’s hand-selected delegates voted to significantly alter the Republican Party Platform.

While it was refreshing to see the overall length of the platform reduced, key policy positions were reduced as well, including the Party’s positon on abortion.

And then yesterday afternoon, the draft was voted on by convention delegates and is now pending final approval.

The overall length of the platform was reduced significantly.

And the language on abortion was changed to:

_"We believe that the 14th Amendment to the Constitution of the United States guarantees that no person can be denied Life or Liberty without Due Process, and that the States are, therefore, free to pass Laws protecting those Rights.”_
The platform then goes onto state that Republicans:

_[W]ill oppose Late Term Abortion while supporting mothers and policies that advance Prenatal Care, access to Birth Control, and IVF (fertility treatments).”_
To sum it all up:

**1 -** The mention of the 14th Amendment in the platform was a big win for sure, as it took months of lobbying from our team to ensure it was in there, and at least the Platform now has a “north star” affirming what our “Life at Conception” legislation says...that every person, even preborn persons, should have equal rights under the Constitution.
**2 -** However, those who wrote the platform must not have fully read the 14th Amendment as then they make it seem as if ending abortion is merely a state issue, which we know is 100% wrong and the Dobbs decision affirmed that abortion is now a federal AND state issue as it say the decision of abortion was returned to the people and their representatives.
**3 -** There is no mention that abortion is a grave moral evil, which is the core reason we are in the battle to begin with.
**4 -** By only mentioning that the GOP opposes late term abortion, I’m concerned how this will affect our ability to rally Republican leaders to help us end Chemical Abortion Pills as this Sunday Senator J.D. Vance shockingly announced on national TV his support for these dangerous drugs!
Pro-Life Friend, I’m know it could have been way worse.

And next to the Biden’s administration’s support for imposing abortion on every state in the country — _throughout all nine months of a pregnancy_ — I know many people would take virtually anything.

There were also things we wanted left out that thankfully were that I’m not going to bother getting into.

And I also know the media is using this to try and deflate pro-lifers ahead of November.

But the fact remains that many in the Republican Party are continuing to run away from the abortion issue.

The Party may win in November, but it needs to be rebuilt from the ground up.

Whether or not the GOP wants _Students for Life Action_ to . . . that’s exactly what we’ve been doing at the state level ever since _Roe’s_ reversal.

That’s where the fight to save lives is — and where we’re making such a big impact as pro-lifers continually crush pro-abortion Republicans at the polls.

Soon the “farm team” you’re helping us build will bring about a new Republican Party that will stand strong for every innocent life in America.

That’s the good news and your reason for hope today.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

name: Shift WA
subject: FWD: Introducing Our New Podcast
body:
Did you hear the news?

We've launched a new podcast dedicated to bringing you insightful conversations about the pressing issues facing Washington state - all with a healthy dose of humor.
The podcast is hosted by Washington state residents and includes interviews with conservative thinkers and leaders sharing their perspectives and solutions for our state's challenges. [Listen to the inaugural, introductory podcast today](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/63376918:Wyzu8YWNz:m:1:2610672541:34BBDFB7B43190DB80250F642D0D5085:r) - and don't forget to [subscribe](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/63376919:Wyzu8YWNz:m:1:2610672541:34BBDFB7B43190DB80250F642D0D5085:r)!

We'd also be grateful if you could [share the podcast with friends and family](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/63376920:Wyzu8YWNz:m:1:2610672541:34BBDFB7B43190DB80250F642D0D5085:r) who might be interested. Your support helps us grow and reach more people who care about the future of our state!

\- The Shift WA Team

P.S. We'd love to hear your thoughts on the podcast. Feel free to reply to this email!
We've just added a new podcast dedicated to bringing you insightful conversations about the pressing issues facing Washington state. This podcast is for those of us who are deeply concerned about what's happening right in our own backyard--from rising crime rates to the constant addition of new tax hikes. | | [](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/63376921:Wyzu8YWNz:m:1:2610672541:34BBDFB7B43190DB80250F642D0D5085:r "Shift Washington")
---
| Friends,

We are excited to announce a fantastic new addition to Shift WA's content lineup!
We've just added a new podcast dedicated to bringing you insightful conversations about the pressing issues facing Washington state. This podcast is for those of us who are deeply concerned about what's happening right in our own backyard--from rising crime rates to the constant addition of new tax hikes. The podcast is hosted by life-long Washington state residents and includes interviews with conservative thinkers and leaders sharing their perspectives and solutions for our state's challenges. **[Listen to the inaugural, introductory podcast today](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/63376922:Wyzu8YWNz:m:1:2610672541:34BBDFB7B43190DB80250F642D0D5085:r)** **- and don't forget to [subscribe](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/63376923:Wyzu8YWNz:m:1:2610672541:34BBDFB7B43190DB80250F642D0D5085:r)!
** Past episodes (also available) included guests like:

* The Washington Policy Center's Todd Myers on environmental policies and the Freedom Conservatism movement.
* Stand With Us Northwest's Randy Kessler on antisemitism in the Northwest.
* The National Review's Charles C.W. Cooke on the need for federalism and why Washington is no exception.
* The American Enterprise Institute's Rick Hess on the conservative vision for improving education.
* The Cato Institute's Colin Grabow on the Jones Act.

[**Take just one moment to subscribe now and stay up-to-date with our latest episodes.**](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/63376923:Wyzu8YWNz:m:1:2610672541:34BBDFB7B43190DB80250F642D0D5085:r)

Thank you for being a part of the Shift WA community. We can't wait for you to join us on this new podcasting journey!

\- The Shift WA Team

P.S. Help us spread the word with friends and family who might also be interested in our new podcast by [sharing the news today](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/63376920:Wyzu8YWNz:m:1:2610672541:34BBDFB7B43190DB80250F642D0D5085:r)! | [ DONATE ](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/63376924:Wyzu8YWNz:m:1:2610672541:34BBDFB7B43190DB80250F642D0D5085:r)
---

If you would like to send this message to some of your friends, you can [click here](http://click.shiftwa.org/forwardthis/ft.php?mID=14571575&em=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&ch=49000b887de404a22f48ed48dd2d4356&schema=echo3) to do so.

You can also stay up to date on our efforts to shift the debate in Washington State by following us on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/shiftwa/) & [Twitter](https://twitter.com/ShiftWA). name: The Babylon Bee
subject: A Special Message from Babylon Bee CEO Seth Dillon
body:
"Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."

| | | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7189e2c1ceeb4b569c4b814610595787&_e=jf6ouc9vgJAvEIMdT_QV5xQ8pJZ7CVadF48u70SE1FzEjU0y2dmCPG7CBzEbbq7sFFP7ewKSb4zT1hWHZhzJ5-G4ow3nvTRz-Jp9RGeuQQA-8S5FGSd6AOJ-3EpNa_x2aYo8l-rAQ4cUs4z82FkjvCLkjjZqBSu1aRgbJYN8XyqYsP0dqQ_mNXsK5TRxkuEdbuHqmjlVh6ZF2Becb_IPjmnXRYFNFP49qR9hYqHG1Z0_7rWgLd5imvHg9OpaqBizYnL6oHl82UtfhOgAHQGddg%3D%3D)
---
|
---
Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7189e2c1ceeb4b569c4b814610595787&_e=jf6ouc9vgJAvEIMdT_QV5xQ8pJZ7CVadF48u70SE1FzEjU0y2dmCPG7CBzEbbq7sFFP7ewKSb4zT1hWHZhzJ5-G4ow3nvTRz-Jp9RGeuQQA-8S5FGSd6AOJ-3EpNa_x28OiNCYWm4-v5_CWGeptupbtNX4ApfvA-DAn2dAyb0GaSbYjdSRmneTUNJpLoQ9-5iCsC2yIE_9VbjYHNFS7M_Ku_wCjffnMOCNmbWze_qTHgvGHM3DV85QjkD5P_tCMUfRHDHk84K4RZeUdAcJz1BQ%3D%3D)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It 's clear to us that what the censors want is submission. **They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They're asking us if we're willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier. ** ** **Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.** ** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers. ** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7189e2c1ceeb4b569c4b814610595787&_e=jf6ouc9vgJAvEIMdT_QV5xQ8pJZ7CVadF48u70SE1FzEjU0y2dmCPG7CBzEbbq7sFFP7ewKSb4zT1hWHZhzJ5-G4ow3nvTRz-Jp9RGeuQQA-8S5FGSd6AOJ-3EpNa_x2X0SUlUR8oITrJ03eoTbP11IlxSwZAgghCcRbFO9yds6tDoqtM7vLkwnEgZaHLKJPoxgGjwg1dMFE-vegRwy3OkflYxafFwkAS_dQbXLYP47S1u3srCEUkyMjnTcreX9GV4CkLexD5YWsKP2PdgfozQ%3D%3D)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7189e2c1ceeb4b569c4b814610595787&_e=jf6ouc9vgJAvEIMdT_QV5xQ8pJZ7CVadF48u70SE1FzEjU0y2dmCPG7CBzEbbq7sFFP7ewKSb4zT1hWHZhzJ5-G4ow3nvTRz-Jp9RGeuQQA-8S5FGSd6AOJ-3EpNa_x2cxQo6K9oDJHZkFQ_FCLGKA2PkpuXV43plUJQ2zefmcU6cSMn1aeBn-83ybk9V-XESYU8ygXconxeerui0ou3IbX100piuIGCEE6sT2N-tE795U6lCdpTSrTe0-SqUXz28yQ4ATffBm-B4Abnou6R3Q%3D%3D)
---
Thanks for standing with us. We will continue to stand with you. Sincerely, Seth Dillon

body:

## Biden Faces New Calls to Withdraw
A day after Democrats appeared to unify behind President Biden, a flurry of new critics [expressed doubts](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLtu6zAQBb9G6mgsl6_rgsVt3DltSoFaLu0NKFGQCBv5-0CpUx6cYgbzeZ_uSaqsj4-0cOylTYm6vHgKSmuFdrJjjoUZ2YwcdUAI4IzD8RmhmJw8AiVrUiqO3dVzDuAtO_JXPUpEQAtBaw2AWl9CcOkfzKGYOc-60GCBs_S2X76arP3JpX63F-8XastY47P37RjM_wFvA97StvL7OK9z7F2o8oC3jWs7RM2SeVUnT3Fl6tJWlXlptKd-KGMMQQg2M9nM4MggGWfQudkVj2HcY97eUqscPgwWHkuS-mvR_27yivgTAAD__5FtYdY) about Biden's ability to lead the party in November. Sen. Michael Bennet of Colorado became the [first Senate Democrat](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD2PozAQQH-N6Yw85sNJ4eIaulx7JRqbcZiTsRHMBuXfr7L11q94T-_fY34gZy7Pv7iRl1RnjMIvmp0G0Laf-2bxichS15AHZ40zQzfYZvUOlw4GvN8gJhq6MdzJ4AgI9wSWXGzYW2N74wDAGAvQOjfgzQSXurAESFH1hhaWerT_KxdZKeV3fdHRxro12a8i-6m6P8pOyk7XdbUlxELX-eHKTnvNLBxPZaePSFOmKFyLstPGcUXKOlApJDrxcYo-qaCQXmir8UDRJ7514IWKjlhEB0LRcnxtuz5iQRjBDF1z-GW_OGc-R6d689yQ80-f_H7r5e13AAAA__9eLW4z) to publicly say President Biden couldn't win the election, and Congressional Black Caucus Member Rep. Marc Veasey broke with his caucus to encourage vulnerable Democrats to go their own way. ABC News anchor George Stephanopoulos, who interviewed Biden last week, said on Tuesday that he [didn't think Biden could](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FurDAQAL_GdKDdxYd5hYvXuLu0KZENa3BkWATOkcvXR5c69Ugzmvf7cPcpp21-8yvbEmXwY0kPHkyNWJMedDXZyEzcVmzREBi4tTeqFhuAfKfJdHqMYHrusRvbGJDxnwfuuUqWgDQYRAQgxMaYm-8hmNiGKWAclQaeUpGj-ZC0lYVjfsqDj2aUtcp2KWU_VftfkVPkrutq_FeS80UVuZdbkQOjyCEocjPLMXN9Ft4Xv8kun1nOOqSJt7qs37XfJcv8rA477VfKOZ2dURrm1af8Wyx__z8s_QQAAP__5tJcmQ) serve another four years. He later apologized for the comment. Top Democrat fundraiser and international film star George Clooney published an op-ed on Wednesday calling for Biden to step down. "[We are not going to win](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL8GNiI4g0kGhi7e0rWjZcxhX4O5yKGJ_PdVOnd-0nvS-7qO14kK1eVz2jC0zOM0N3ri6JUxCuxoZQoZEbCTGIwH7bXrHMg1mEvus7XYJ2edMSlHry8RMPmLPVsHkgJosNobY7QGY07eu-mso89dTNHkWViNiRrvp2-m2lbM5eAn7qeZN1nC2tr9IboPAYOAoa24UilvJmCIhZeHgIGqaiuqW-WXgMH6vjsbpxbkfUE1F-aKh4qUsKq0813xT1MVX-rg_aYabfiWyD2k-4tKoUfvhdXLNtFfSLb_lzwD_AYAAP__KAxjOw) in November with this president," the actor wrote.
## Retirees Drive Growth in U.S. Cities
America's 65-and-older population grew significantly in cities across America from 2020 to 2023, some by nearly 20%. [Here's a map of the growth](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFu7CAQAL8Gd7ZggeNeQfEad5c2pbWG5bwRNpYhdvL30aVOPdKMNO-P6YGceXu-4Uq-pTJhaHzS5HqlejCT6aJPREC6I68cSCetttAtXqG2gMmAoXj7hxZCSvpmZ2VdTJruHXuQYKRTSkkJSg3OWbzL2SU9x1mlIIykyK0cw0fhrS2U8nc56RhCWbvsl9b2KvR_AaOA8bquAb-41BcVML7cAkbpBIxKChhxpYMD9oEbU-0rbVyOfi_7Z8bGZesjreV54L5wqN3h435xzlxvThj5XJHzb7f9feH08BMAAP__VqFfHA). Retirees moving to new homes are driving changes in some cities with especially notable 65+ growth, including Raleigh (+18.3%), Austin (+17.3) and Houston (+15.3%). The overall 65-plus population rose 9.4% to about 59.2 million people in this time frame. [U.S. Census Bureau](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskkFzmzwQhn-NfDOjXSEpHDg4weSb5HPSnpqcGBkWkEeyqBDG_vcdt7l0ptdn993Ds--PQ3Mw1tnz8GY8lakPjWmTvVCjtwBbzJt805U9EZLYUAkaueZSSNyMJedGIJDOu1wbXihNUiAqzbHoeH5UG1six5xrAOAcATKtpXngR92LY3eEvmU5p86mELNTsOc0Uu9u4UIxa4PfuHJMaZqZ2DGsGdbrumYtnedlzoZwYVh3JhmGdTJHRzPDGjmKOyYfGNZTmKYYTl98Oy_em3jb_tnOxuQdE_WSfDOHJbbERHWmdXaUEkWG6j7x1NnFM1GRN9Z9wdb4ydjh_FegMVcb5n5JS6TQj2RcGlsTiaGaUyRzP5LCxFA0g2GiwgxQAIq7FMhB8VwA8gw0SIlCSL4FKKRUAPlDBqrgCA8cgKFqBtMyUUGmuNBSQnEP5QVioWX2dFpfn3anVbzdro_jo9_bdXcLffVphkHt9rf5-cV9-OK_arwOx8_t_uUwxun53R3e5Y2_vn-Y_8fJ0ike5BB-XsMTfFu_7y5V87juN7HsptU6Z2elWc6Hu5Lff0r_bs2lxF8BAAD__xQSvRM) projections show that Americans 65 and older will make up more than 20% of the population by 2030 and are expected to reach 23% by 2050.

The wife and two adult daughters of BBC racing commentator John Hunt [were killed in a crossbow attack](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uwyAYAJ8Gb1jwmQR7YOjiLV07Wvx8BFpsIsBBefsqnbuddMNJ93XbbjqmeNw_9Y6q-bxp2-ITN0k5pyA2MTjlEQGnARWXwCS7TBcYgtLGoEHwzIoZBDjkdrkCXie3zMs0L0NUwEAwyTlnDDgfpbzomRnpJ-MM95YIhi62XMbvHI8W0KdXfmIZbd6HpEJrj0qmDwIrgbX3PlpTD-z17QmsbySwnj-0lfhISPezOCzUllyryZ3u-gjn0ag5a8AXDViaz8XVEAsSWIei3KPHlGK9SiLYfdcx_bXb_yeeCn4DAAD__yrEYzM) on Tuesday night in Bushey, a quiet suburb northwest of London. subject: A Special Message from Babylon Bee CEO Seth Dillon
body:
"Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."

| | | [](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=63123feb6d824971b90323b01ccaa6e5&_e=1CGSbb_r9ERFOdSoQCn0F-gchcR0lMRpTof7lOyM9__W_wN4fo6ufZoocfoFccDm3AyYWj3KuaDAcGepdAxdt7Z16cZy1cXd4tH0RmszpYCRJLGELoLqRnTmyW7OYOTa4Uv4MBVftGjd5EaDjPMT8bZuIHfsZheWY5SFyTJkp9n7HSEXV1fJVLB3lmfzWWvEgbU1SuEw50F2MH9Q9CAKxuaitGQqGQL2eQHiyDEZPqK1yLQLAT3s1VhgK_p8hdqJD5U4u3yP6NRHQSoFWK3b2w%3D%3D)
---
|
---
Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=63123feb6d824971b90323b01ccaa6e5&_e=1CGSbb_r9ERFOdSoQCn0F-gchcR0lMRpTof7lOyM9__W_wN4fo6ufZoocfoFccDm3AyYWj3KuaDAcGepdAxdt7Z16cZy1cXd4tH0RmszpYCRJLGELoLqRnTmyW7OYOTa0D9XGLL0ywT061QCVZD48zvcxQQbzfiATnljpIFGPY9bW__Ik7EiRz7AZU6ykIVjTf_CeXGyDPCXaTfNIP0o81mQlLClbq07Qj7kdc0fHpQkNfHpkBaz4QVsz7FpAidMtp4YKV9AyiguAA4VkSX1Nw%3D%3D)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It 's clear to us that what the censors want is submission. **They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They're asking us if we're willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier. ** ** **Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.** ** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers. ** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=63123feb6d824971b90323b01ccaa6e5&_e=1CGSbb_r9ERFOdSoQCn0F-gchcR0lMRpTof7lOyM9__W_wN4fo6ufZoocfoFccDm3AyYWj3KuaDAcGepdAxdt7Z16cZy1cXd4tH0RmszpYCRJLGELoLqRnTmyW7OYOTan2VOn6HUIahvpJ5ngrTiiRJEmO2vTY5Q8vdu_spdYLEdSLNL4sQ-etAxoD0ssgOx2-4QILBAoXeCDkZkHSrUxnEZphKqVlw-jI5VYebnJrWzKvN651JccV9_phEbvAz1ZsZF0CdfY07-cc-RD8giQQ%3D%3D)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=63123feb6d824971b90323b01ccaa6e5&_e=1CGSbb_r9ERFOdSoQCn0F-gchcR0lMRpTof7lOyM9__W_wN4fo6ufZoocfoFccDm3AyYWj3KuaDAcGepdAxdt7Z16cZy1cXd4tH0RmszpYCRJLGELoLqRnTmyW7OYOTa2GEe84O93sazok88jJy8b_R6NiJN7lOD9cSmW4sGqBgiKaGWY9KobDB_UskGD2m0SBsbFAGjOpAj99kDEhGgUsHJ7xcn8AmmilgUbcBmjEx0Ap4QJuhDoXmsakn7vbVGvdbenbvNNVzLiUQjaJWB8Q%3D%3D)

# NATO Summit 2024
---
| [](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2u2v5n-e2wxt9-kyd76rh6/)
---
**The 2024 NATO Summit in Washington, D.C. celebrates its 75th anniversary** with a renewed commitment to unity and security. This gathering brings together leaders from 32 NATO Allies, including newest member states, Sweden and Finland. Central to the summit's agenda is the reaffirmation of**NATO's steadfast support for Ukraine** during ongoing Russian aggression. President Biden emphasizes the Alliance's commitment to collective defense highlighting NATO's role in **enhancing Ukraine's defense capabilities t** hrough initiatives like the**deployment of a NATO Senior Representative in Kyiv** . With **23 Allies now meeting or exceeding the two percent GDP defense spending commitment** , NATO's defense industrial base is being strengthened to ensure readiness and resilience to diverse threats across air, land, sea, cyber, and space. A **$10 billion commitment to arms production** by NATO for defense and industrial cooperation among Allies. Additionally, there are efforts to**extend NATO's partnerships** in the Indo-Pacific- including **South Korea, Japan and Australia.** Other efforts include implementing real-time threat intelligence, and addressing vulnerabilities through integrated cyber defense centers. Inclusive security policies are also on the agenda, with NATO's updated Women, Peace, and Security policy addressing new security threats such as **technology-enabled gender-based violence and climate security**. The Alliance's commitment to supporting women in the Ukrainian armed services reflects NATO's broader goals of**promoting gender equality** and advancing extensive security objectives. # [Australia used to be called New Holland.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sggh9g&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [World History](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sggh9g&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sggh9g&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| I n 1606, toward the end of Europe’s age of exploration, Dutch explorer Willem Janszoon landed on the western side of Australia’s Cape York Peninsula, believing he was on the shores of New Guinea, which is separated from mainland Australia by the Torres Strait. He mapped 186 miles of coastline before departing later that year. Other Dutch navigators followed suit, charting the northern, western, and southern coasts of the landmass. Despite the fact that the Dutch never never colonized Australia, by the late 17th century the continent was known as New Holland (Nieuw-Holland in Dutch) — but the name didn’t last.
---
In 1768, British explorer James Cook made the first of his three voyages to Australia. Two years later, he claimed the eastern half for Britain and renamed it New South Wales. A secret goal of Cook’s first voyage was to discover what was listed on ancient maps as Terra Australis Incognita (Latin for Unknown South Land), a hypothetical vast landmass that the Greek philosophers theorized must exist in the Southern Hemisphere to counterbalance Asia. By the end of Captain Cook’s third voyage, he had seen portions of Antarctica and mapped enough of New Zealand ([also named by Dutch explorers](https://track.historyfacts.com/?xtl=64ci07v6dnhp8thlkjcbsw85iu7l9hxot3h7loaxjan06p10bu6dblmmvdlzyktq6eemst8p2f5x3qh6i3jby9c8x53hcab6puncvs4iz144qi0ys2ckdo29ybzv4aae524smslwbbf5fg2vhwoffcegnb1brkqpnwrg5jz9aq2pvlrd4ypk084qipik1aatmsg7ykarv15zei4uygow44a579ds6t8yom3vok41e1ot664zy7k39ozune0d1s4828t9a&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sggh9g&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)) to disprove that Australia was part of the fabled Terra Australis; rather, a separate southern continent was located in the icy polar region.
In 1803, British navigator Matthew Flinders became the first person to circumnavigate the coast of Australia, charting unknown parts of the coastline and proving that Australia is a single continent. In his journals and maps of the expedition, he harkened back to Terra Australis when naming the continent, but shortened it to Australia. This time, the name stuck. As Flinders wrote in _A Voyage to Terra Australis_ (1814), the new, abridged moniker was “[more agreeable to the ear](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sggh9g&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com).”

## Australia was once a penal colony.
In 1787, 11 ships holding nearly 1,400 people left Portsmouth, England, for Botany Bay, Australia. This “First Fleet” carried new settlers, and more than 700 convicts. This is not as unusual as it may seem. The British had been sending convicts to work off their sentences in the colonies since 1615. After the American Revolution, British convicts were sent to New South Wales and Van Diemen’s Land (modern-day Tasmania). Between 1788 and 1868, more than 162,000 convicts were transported to Australia. Some were exiled in lieu of the death penalty, while others were sent more than 9,000 miles from home to serve sentences for more trivial crimes, including petty theft and fraud. Once free, many ex-convicts remained in Australia and joined the ranks of the free settlers. Today, an estimated 20% of Australians are the descendants of convicts.

clean_body: In 1606, toward the end of Europe’s age of exploration, Dutch explorer Willem Janszoon landed on the western side of Australia’s Cape York Peninsula, believing he was on the shores of New Guinea, which is separated from mainland Australia by the Torres Strait. | I n 1606, toward the end of Europe’s age of exploration, Dutch explorer Willem Janszoon landed on the western side of Australia’s Cape York Peninsula, believing he was on the shores of New Guinea, which is separated from mainland Australia by the Torres Strait. He mapped 186 miles of coastline before departing later that year. Other Dutch navigators followed suit, charting the northern, western, and southern coasts of the landmass. Despite the fact that the Dutch never never colonized Australia, by the late 17th century the continent was known as New Holland (Nieuw-Holland in Dutch) — but the name didn’t last. In 1768, British explorer James Cook made the first of his three voyages to Australia. Two years later, he claimed the eastern half for Britain and renamed it New South Wales. A secret goal of Cook’s first voyage was to discover what was listed on ancient maps as Terra Australis Incognita (Latin for Unknown South Land), a hypothetical vast landmass that the Greek philosophers theorized must exist in the Southern Hemisphere to counterbalance Asia. By the end of Captain Cook’s third voyage, he had seen portions of Antarctica and mapped enough of New Zealand () to disprove that Australia was part of the fabled Terra Australis; rather, a separate southern continent was located in the icy polar region. In 1803, British navigator Matthew Flinders became the first person to circumnavigate the coast of Australia, charting unknown parts of the coastline and proving that Australia is a single continent. In his journals and maps of the expedition, he harkened back to Terra Australis when naming the continent, but shortened it to Australia. This time, the name stuck. In 1787, 11 ships holding nearly 1,400 people left Portsmouth, England, for Botany Bay, Australia. This “First Fleet” carried new settlers, and more than 700 convicts. This is not as unusual as it may seem. The British had been sending convicts to work off their sentences in the colonies since 1615. After the American Revolution, British convicts were sent to New South Wales and Van Diemen’s Land (modern-day Tasmania). Between 1788 and 1868, more than 162,000 convicts were transported to Australia. Some were exiled in lieu of the death penalty, while others were sent more than 9,000 miles from home to serve sentences for more trivial crimes, including petty theft and fraud. Once free, many ex-convicts remained in Australia and joined the ranks of the free settlers. Today, an estimated 20% of Australians are the descendants of convicts. | | | I endured the gauntlet of West Point Military Academy, then boot camp, then became a Tank Platoon Leader in the final days of the Cold War.

I briefed President Trump on America's most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

And I stood eye-to-eye with the most dangerous dictators in the world as Trump's Secretary of State.

**It takes a lot to make me feel on edge. So the fact that I 'm even sending you this email should give you pause. **

Because I'm afraid we have a problem. A big one.

I just got word that Joe Biden and the Democrats are _closer than they 've ever been before_ to destroying our Conservative House Majority once and for all. The latest reports show they've stockpiled over $100,000,000 to defeat us in enough swing states to bring forth a COMPLETE LIBERAL TAKEOVER.

The ONLY THING standing in the way of Joe Biden having full control - and ramming through any radical policy he wants - is just a few competitive House seats. That's it.

I don't tell you this lightly and I know that's not what you want to see happen to our country.

_**[That's why I'm rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a958dda712b14d06bda8602ff748bfaa&_e=_8lHQsSwHk_v5f9hn6uScNsBeLLyTMuKIKpvRe0IEfCzhbn3xasgu-rgCBzj-agHLXEaF-eAds_mTdjOF3XOGs8VFBFoYW6IRx84tcdpFZ7Ta8qME1I6de48YT1RXjc4qrAd7_RRedAUjulUlP5XSWY4qETLggMFKiOzDA91A5yjkqtbgda8tQC_QYhOegPic-DHDrpOkaQRf6EBZUOUreb-K5clpJgC2iL2_RzdGSIbGwqwzZ0eso1QGmIGU28gteof5BC9VanccKxEQRpn5_oRTa2FqKVG2Kc-q86QGOjrHsRaOOJ5wnHYfGv1dzsLmrnheOsHUiWHOBrifwCJUmH-f00KvLfwPbE9so3eayCPNOOvMdWuOsfThkb4Gbz4wkzKOwbgjVCelcWwlKubbShgALiHBH_YrjM0zF0GTEcZNGALMIZ5Rviwx3ykVdLl01nXABKlUgvVz3hOn_1hwA%3D%3D "That’s why I’m rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.")**_ I know what you're thinking... that's not enough runway to raise that much. If all you can spare is ten or twenty bucks, that would be incredible. If you can afford more that's even better. I only ask that everyone give something.

Will you do what it takes to hand Joe Biden and the Democrats a humiliating defeat?

body:
I briefed President Trump on America's most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

| |

---
| | | I endured the gauntlet of West Point Military Academy, then boot camp, then became a Tank Platoon Leader in the final days of the Cold War.

I briefed President Trump on America's most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

And I stood eye-to-eye with the most dangerous dictators in the world as Trump's Secretary of State.

**It takes a lot to make me feel on edge. So the fact that I 'm even sending you this email should give you pause. **

Because I'm afraid we have a problem. A big one.

I just got word that Joe Biden and the Democrats are _closer than they 've ever been before_ to destroying our Conservative House Majority once and for all. The latest reports show they've stockpiled over $100,000,000 to defeat us in enough swing states to bring forth a COMPLETE LIBERAL TAKEOVER.

The ONLY THING standing in the way of Joe Biden having full control - and ramming through any radical policy he wants - is just a few competitive House seats. That's it.

I don't tell you this lightly and I know that's not what you want to see happen to our country.

_**[That's why I'm rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6c745e686eb642afa34e1d311c150cdc&_e=5aQpjFIGVgyN9DKdiiTBU-wdU_QoNLBIgbT0DhjyTHjrYtY12MdL_jrx5Nq9thokgMyLeXdXfAKqcFiugJ1G1K4L-dNro8pWd0lZPnsANnG2id4lg2iSpbkN0iIbw_UO7B1VFY3fPDDBoxM6vq4ZuJiGUXIhx2hqkKjyI47dNzv_ua-sqdlqD6aNaM7UpkRlG4WiZTcI83498HFPJrn56TiOjoTdsQVJkbFVHTxQxI9w_Y221kj5mZW6gB-b-vhaCI_wKQ9m5a4ZYb9R1W0JJvBSGoh1_tqO9zcOD0xbtK-OrRnYTSuTVCPXTU5FWLO7jbcSLX0z3W-PsG-1qQfys6W6f5Z1sIyQb8Gh4UV6nlPRCCQxTdKLD8m4WrqNTtfQfG8cPnc1wj0OqIqaFU4Pce-M7cok1jZWBfj1u8HxUj3lJRRblb1GYImSmTXyVLmBHiowQnBKi8X3jALSits_Pg%3D%3D "That’s why I’m rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.")**_ I know what you're thinking... that's not enough runway to raise that much. But desperate times call for desperate measures. And if that's what it'll take to win, I'm willing to chase down every lead.

If all you can spare is ten or twenty bucks, that would be incredible. If you can afford more that's even better. I only ask that everyone give something.

Will you do what it takes to hand Joe Biden and the Democrats a humiliating defeat?

**A Message from Senator John Barrasso:**

[](http://links.myfreedomnews.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=d9d9cae2e66646219135f91712b3e03b&_e=F6A8fycVy8EbvmGzJmDEDQ4Uf2tiOBXzmBCBdNlV9S8M_mo_ISvHp70N6ggS9QX7h33RdWXIp4eiLM03EV0hLlNoQoz27L7LoVGx_AqM8Kc5R2QsqxoQHrlgsGvux-XjRpYY9jJMQ-dpXLGvw9GuuRvsL_aYGBJ8bMJNCo9NX2q_t_NgeM4mCUaanD6ZzeYxaqozBAeM0eKrBO2yiLho6BZ11T1vmrIZROApO-QwQ-6y9AXd2BQSP8ONWPeJT34p4vqDmUgWLtuG4XFpiFUndw%3D%3D)
I want to take a moment to remind you of my journey to the U.S. Senate, the important le ssons I have learned along the way, and why I continue to believe wholeheartedly in our beloved state.

My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. My mother, a dedicated voter who never missed an election, instilled in me the importance of civic duty.

From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming.

Later, in medical school, I learned the importance of having a plan before taking action, a lesson that has proven invaluable in both my medical career and my service as your senator. Just as in surgery, effective leadership requires a clear vision and a strategic approach to problem-solving.

As you may know, I am sometimes referred to as _"Wyoming's doctor,"_ but to be honest, that is what I have always strived to be as your senator. I have wholeheartedly dedicated myself to serving the state, addressing its challenges, and making it the best it can be.

**_Whether it's advocating for our veterans, championing American energy security, or safeguarding our borders, I've always strived to be a voice for all Wyoming people. Your concerns are my concerns, and your aspirations are my aspirations._**

As we look towards the future, I'm confident that Wyoming has the potential to be an even stronger, more prosperous state. **[But it will require strong leadership, a clear vision, and your continued support.](http://links.myfreedomnews.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=d9d9cae2e66646219135f91712b3e03b&_e=F6A8fycVy8EbvmGzJmDEDQ4Uf2tiOBXzmBCBdNlV9S8M_mo_ISvHp70N6ggS9QX7h33RdWXIp4eiLM03EV0hLlNoQoz27L7LoVGx_AqM8Kc5R2QsqxoQHrlgsGvux-Xj0GxVAZ4tkdrnFyaAUUW3nXzIGki-XFVLLnRO3CF8Bv52ymzPIoPJMjQoXL5j1nFSBEuJY9r-S7CNR8pWUSykWODFFu-SKAMye2TfCbLIPz_NmEgnzHnXcgpYEzAfpYqAxM48VkuCX4QrNPAtN3tA0w%3D%3D)**

Already, your support has been instrumental in my journey, and I promise to continue fighting for the issues that matter most to Wyoming families.

Sincerely,
Senator John Barrasso [CHIP IN FOR A STRONG WYOMING](http://links.myfreedomnews.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=d9d9cae2e66646219135f91712b3e03b&_e=F6A8fycVy8EbvmGzJmDEDQ4Uf2tiOBXzmBCBdNlV9S8M_mo_ISvHp70N6ggS9QX7h33RdWXIp4eiLM03EV0hLlNoQoz27L7LoVGx_AqM8Kc5R2QsqxoQHrlgsGvux-Xj8dlnLn4ANDz3HTsluzPtTLf3W7ExCnz5Ugdxu-8SixJZkZhXaVD0BYBRJBFF_s-_98ng4yATnO34WAwBGADgAmdU4izxHe07AEeMNUDMTCZ-Bd6UmD6kRxZpJHTwfdQT91QHU6D0GvJHLYgwemEUqw%3D%3D)

Your input is vital in setting the direction of our Republican agenda. ✅ Border/Immigration ✅ Inflation/Economy ✅ First Amendment ✅ Foreign Policy ✅ Energy ✅ Law and Order Your answers will help guide our discussions and decisions at the convention, ensuring that we focus on what matters most to you and our great nation. Together, we can ensure that our Party represents our values and can better lead America towards a brighter future. Thank you for your commitment, Sen. Barrasso A Message from Senator John Barrasso: I want to take a moment to remind you of my journey to the U.S. Senate, the important le ssons I have learned along the way, and why I continue to believe wholeheartedly in our beloved state. My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. My mother, a dedicated voter who never missed an election, instilled in me the importance of civic duty. From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming. Later, in medical school, I learned the importance of having a plan before taking action, a lesson that has proven invaluable in both my medical career and my service as your senator. Just as in surgery, effective leadership requires a clear vision and a strategic approach to problem-solving. As you may know, I am sometimes referred to as "Wyoming's doctor," but to be honest, that is what I have always strived to be as your senator. I have wholeheartedly dedicated myself to serving the state, addressing its challenges, and making it the best it can be. Whether it's advocating for our veterans, championing American energy security, or safeguarding our borders, I've always strived to be a voice for all Wyoming people. Your concerns are my concerns, and your aspirations are my aspirations. As we look towards the future, I'm confident that Wyoming has the potential to be an even stronger, more prosperous state. ** Already, your support has been instrumental in my journey, and I promise to continue fighting for the issues that matter most to Wyoming families. Sincerely, Senator John Barrasso | Paid for by Friends of John Barrasso This message reflects the opinions and representations of Friends of John Barrasso. subject: A Special Message from Babylon Bee CEO Seth Dillon
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.libertyledger.)
---
|
---
Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](http://trk.libertyledger.)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It 's clear to us that what the censors want is submission. **They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They're asking us if we're willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](http://trk.libertyledger.)**** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](http://trk.libertyledger._Kl_ZmS4v86XB1g)
---
Thanks for standing with us. We will continue to stand with you. Sincerely,Seth Dillon
CEO, The Babylon Bee

name: Glenn Youngkin
subject: The Top State for Business
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Spirit of Virginia
body:
To view this email as a web page, click
https://view.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=e840acd9e6c7ef146b959b1c5c2ad1622c2409dd7d42b71fd5e1617d2d8bb5ebb779c376d87dbaf57bb495f3f8074edf486e2249c1d689f2cbeba47a3a8cc6d7816bee27d64f4e871125b79485e8316f
here.

Dear Friend,

When Virginians hired me as their Governor, they hired an outsider and businessman. I promised that I would put my business acumen to work for Virginia on Day One, and that’s exactly what I did.

We enacted $5 billion in tax relief for Virginia families so they could keep more of their hard-earned money, because that money belongs to the people who work for it and not the government. We slashed red-tape, freeing our job creators from the regulatory burdens that were stifling business innovation and growth. We invested more than $550 million to support business ready site development and make Virginia attractive for large businesses.

As the Chief Economic Development Officer for the Commonwealth of Virginia, I am proud of what we have accomplished so far. And I am so proud to announce that Virginia was just named the Top State for Business by CNBC.

We have regained the honor of America’s top state for business because commonsense conservative leadership and policies work.

We have created 240,000 new jobs, and more people are working in Virginia than ever before in the history of our Commonwealth.

We have had $74 billion in capital commitments to Virginia from companies investing here. We have welcomed iconic companies like Boeing, Amazon Web Services, Raytheon, LEGO, and have seen major expansions here from companies like Hilton and Northrop Grumman.

We implemented an All-American, All-of-the-Above Energy Plan to make sure people and businesses have access to affordable, reliable, and increasingly clean power.

We have prioritized the wellbeing of all our citizens with record investments in education and behavioral health.

We have proven that when you lower taxes, reduce regulations, invest in business-ready sites, and allow the entrepreneurial spirit that is unique to America thrive, then businesses and the jobs they support will prosper.

This is what commonsense conservative leadership can deliver, and we are just getting started.

Thank you to all of our partners, and to the great businesses large and small, for believing in Virginia. Thank you for your continued support as we are making Virginia not only the best place to live, work, and raise a family, but the Top State for Business in 2024.

God Bless,

Governor Glenn Youngkin

Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/7sgyCdzevMnlWMjjy-ML4Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRocmokP0RSaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucz91dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPUFNRlI1MTQyNVcDc3BjQgpmjiTUj2ZMMDc_UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/7sgyCdzevMnlWMjjy-ML4Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRocmokP0RSaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucz91dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPUFNRlI1MTQyNVcDc3BjQgpmjiTUj2ZMMDc_UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/7sgyCdzevMnlWMjjy-ML4Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRocmokP0RSaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucz91dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPUFNRlI1MTQyNVcDc3BjQgpmjiTUj2ZMMDc_UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 7/11/2024
body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi folks!
I wanted to personally invite you to join me at the 2024-2025 [Leadership Program of the Rockies](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) South Metro Summer Recruiting Event! If you've hung out in any political circles in Colorado, you've probably met at least one (if not hundreds) of LPR grads... in fact, me, my husband, my dad AND my daughter are all graduates of the program. Come learn more about how to join the 'Army of Freedom' on Tuesday, August 20th from 6-7pm at Lone Tree Arts Center -- [register here!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

Not in South Denver? Check out [more events](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) here. Can't wait to see you there!
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, July 11, 2024.
- Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Ashbaugh: How a Latino Democrat and a Black Republican opened a white, middle-aged woman's eyes ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), COMMENTARY
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_" I'm a Republican." he said._
_" Ohhhh, I never pegged you to be that. I don't think we can be friends anymore," I laughed, only half-kidding. I was what one would consider a "Far Left" Democrat living in Boulder, CO when I said this, and Republicans were "the enemy."_
_The Republican friend of mine who I so quickly judged, as we reconnected after years of not seeing each other, was Lavelle Lewis, a football and basketball player who I 'd cheered for during our years at IHS in Rochester, NY. After a couple of cups of coffee, I realized that as liberal as I was, Lavelle and I weren't so different._
_Believe it or not, our values, morals, and political perspectives were rooted in similar ideals, just with different approaches to how we felt things should be handled. His historical and global understanding made me realize that my "deep-rooted Democratic beliefs" were actually not rooted in anything other than assumptions and headlines. _
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Dueling meetings planned to decide future of party's leadership](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Rival factions within the Colorado Republican Party are planning separate meetings to consider the removal of Dave Williams as state party chairman. One faction, aligned with Williams, is planning a brief meeting to recess immediately, while another faction is seeking a substantive session to potentially oust Williams and other party officers.
* The conflict stems from disagreements over Williams' leadership style and actions, including his public statements and election results, which have prompted calls for his removal from party leadership.
* The situation has led to legal threats and confusion among party members, with potential implications for the party's organization and leadership ahead of upcoming elections. The disputes might ultimately require intervention from the Republican National Committee or legal resolution.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Many Colorado schools will split $11.4M in Juul lawsuit settlement funds for vaping education, prevention](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) ** [CHALKBEAT COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado has allocated $11.4 million from a settlement with Juul Labs to fund vaping education and prevention programs across 21 school districts, seven charter schools, and other educational organizations over the next three years.
* The settlement funds stem from a $31.7 million lawsuit settlement with Juul Labs, where Colorado accused the company of targeting youth with deceptive marketing and downplaying health risks, without Juul admitting any wrongdoing.
* The majority of the settlement will fund a $20 million children's mental health grant program, with smaller grants supporting direct educational initiatives in schools and nonprofits to combat vaping among youth.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Half of Denver voters' top concern is homelessness, one-third say taxes are 'way too high'](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [KDVR](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A recent poll shows that 73% of Denver voters feel safe in the city, an increase from the previous year, and most compare Denver favorably to other large cities.
* Denver voters are split on tax perceptions following a proposed sales tax increase, with 35% finding taxes too high and 35% deeming them reasonable, while concerns primarily focus on homelessness, housing affordability, and safety.
* Views on Denver's leadership are mixed: 48% view Mayor Mike Johnston favorably, though unfavorable opinions have increased, and the Denver City Council and School Board also face significant unfavorable ratings among the electorate.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[House passes fridge, dishwasher bills to hatchet Biden's regulation regime](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE WASHINGTON TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The House passed a pair of bills that would block stricter energy standards for dishwashers and refrigerators as part of the GOP's battle against President Biden's push for more regulations of home appliances.

* The Refrigerator Freedom Act and Stop Unaffordable Dishwasher Standards Act would prevent the Department of Energy from finalizing or enforcing efficiency standards on dishwashers and fridges that "are not cost-effective or technologically feasible."

* The measures would also prevent the Energy Department from applying regulations unless they result in "significant conservation of energy," and if the agency finds that the standards will not increase costs on consumers.

* All Republicans and a handful of Democrats passed both the dishwasher bill by Rep. Nick Langworthy, New York Republican, and the refrigerator bill from Rep. Mariannette Miller-Meeks, Iowa Republican.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Lake: Brand-new Republican Party platform leans into popular MAGA for the masses issues](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE FREE PRESS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), COMMENTARY
_For the last eight years, Donald Trump has ignored a basic rule of politics: always expand your base and appeal to as many supporters as possible. Well, if the new Republican Party platform is any indication, Trump is finally taking this conventional advice about elections. _
_The new document, out this week, is far briefer than past platforms and reads like MAGA for the masses. It 's dedicated to the "forgotten men and women of America." Trump has used the phrase since 2016, but it was made famous after a 1932 radio speech by Franklin Delano Roosevelt. _
_As one might expect, the document emphasizes immigration, Trump 's signature issue. And in some cases the language is extreme. For example, in the all-caps section at the end of the platform's preamble, it promises to "STOP THE MIGRANT INVASION" and to "CARRY OUT THE LARGEST DEPORTATION OPERATION IN AMERICAN HISTORY." _
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**_[Tooker: Why am I opposed to the 400,000-acre proposed Dolores River National Monument?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_** **BY AIMEE TOOKER | COMMENTARY | JULY 9** _The west end of Montrose County is one of four Tier One coal-affected communities in Colorado. The effect of the closure of Western Fuels coal mine in 2018 and Tri-State Generation and Transmission 's coal plant in 2019 (two years ahead of schedule) had an obvious detrimental effect on our local businesses._
**[Wood: Gov. The Republican friend of mine who I so quickly judged, as we reconnected after years of not seeing each other, was Lavelle Lewis, a football and basketball player who I 'd cheered for during our years at IHS in Rochester, NY. After a couple of cups of coffee, I realized that as liberal as I was, Lavelle and I weren't so different. Believe it or not, our values, morals, and political perspectives were rooted in similar ideals, just with different approaches to how we felt things should be handled. His historical and global understanding made me realize that my "deep-rooted Democratic beliefs" were actually not rooted in anything other than assumptions and headlines. | Rival factions within the Colorado Republican Party are planning separate meetings to consider the removal of Dave Williams as state party chairman. One faction, aligned with Williams, is planning a brief meeting to recess immediately, while another faction is seeking a substantive session to potentially oust Williams and other party officers. The conflict stems from disagreements over Williams' leadership style and actions, including his public statements and election results, which have prompted calls for his removal from party leadership. The situation has led to legal threats and confusion among party members, with potential implications for the party's organization and leadership ahead of upcoming elections. The disputes might ultimately require intervention from the Republican National Committee or legal resolution. | Colorado has allocated $11.4 million from a settlement with Juul Labs to fund vaping education and prevention programs across 21 school districts, seven charter schools, and other educational organizations over the next three years. The settlement funds stem from a $31.7 million lawsuit settlement with Juul Labs, where Colorado accused the company of targeting youth with deceptive marketing and downplaying health risks, without Juul admitting any wrongdoing. The majority of the settlement will fund a $20 million children's mental health grant program, with smaller grants supporting direct educational initiatives in schools and nonprofits to combat vaping among youth. | A recent poll shows that 73% of Denver voters feel safe in the city, an increase from the previous year, and most compare Denver favorably to other large cities. Denver voters are split on tax perceptions following a proposed sales tax increase, with 35% finding taxes too high and 35% deeming them reasonable, while concerns primarily focus on homelessness, housing affordability, and safety. Views on Denver's leadership are mixed: 48% view Mayor Mike Johnston favorably, though unfavorable opinions have increased, and the Denver City Council and School Board also face significant unfavorable ratings among the electorate. | The House passed a pair of bills that would block stricter energy standards for dishwashers and refrigerators as part of the GOP's battle against President Biden's push for more regulations of home appliances. The Refrigerator Freedom Act and Stop Unaffordable Dishwasher Standards Act would prevent the Department of Energy from finalizing or enforcing efficiency standards on dishwashers and fridges that "are not cost-effective or technologically feasible." The measures would also prevent the Energy Department from applying regulations unless they result in "significant conservation of energy," and if the agency finds that the standards will not increase costs on consumers. All Republicans and a handful of Democrats passed both the dishwasher bill by Rep. Nick Langworthy, New York Republican, and the refrigerator bill from Rep. Mariannette Miller-Meeks, Iowa Republican. | , COMMENTARY For the last eight years, Donald Trump has ignored a basic rule of politics: always expand your base and appeal to as many supporters as possible. Well, if the new Republican Party platform is any indication, Trump is finally taking this conventional advice about elections. The new document, out this week, is far briefer than past platforms and reads like MAGA for the masses. It 's dedicated to the "forgotten men and women of America." Trump has used the phrase since 2016, but it was made famous after a 1932 radio speech by Franklin Delano Roosevelt. As one might expect, the document emphasizes immigration, Trump 's signature issue. And in some cases the language is extreme. For example, in the all-caps section at the end of the platform's preamble, it promises to "STOP THE MIGRANT INVASION" and to "CARRY OUT THE LARGEST DEPORTATION OPERATION IN AMERICAN HISTORY." | ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ BY JAMESON DION | COMMENTARY | JULY 9 In Colorado, Republican Party politics has been defined in recent years by losses, infighting and a steady decline in the percentage of Colorado voters that affiliate with the party. BY AIMEE TOOKER | COMMENTARY | JULY 9 The west end of Montrose County is one of four Tier One coal-affected communities in Colorado. The effect of the closure of Western Fuels coal mine in 2018 and Tri-State Generation and Transmission 's coal plant in 2019 (two years ahead of schedule) had an obvious detrimental effect on our local businesses. BY PETE WOOD | STATE | JULY 5 This past February, Gov. Jared Polis introduced his "Roadmap 2.0" that aims to cut greenhouse gas emissions in half by 2030 and achieve net-zero emissions in Colorado by 2050. name: Andrew Horne
subject: Get Involved: 19 Days Left to Make a Difference!
body:
My Friends,
As we reach this pivotal point in our campaign, voting has begun but is not over. We've had over 5,000 people nominate me to be their representative, met thousands more personally, had televised debates, and put up thousands of signs.
With only 19 days left, your involvement is more crucial than ever. We are phone banking tonight at 5 pm Arizona time and multiple times a week. On Tuesday, we connected with nearly 1,000 individuals, which makes a huge difference. Phone banking can be done from anywhere in the country—it’s easy and fun. Hop on with us and enjoy the evening together while making a significant impact.
Please sign up here to join us tonight or another time soon! [Phone Banking Sign-Up Link](https://www.mobilize.us/andrewhorneforarizona/event/615720/)
My favorite part of this campaign has been going door to door, meeting new people who share the same ideas and concerns. These encounters remind me why I got involved—to make a difference and work alongside a community that cares deeply about our future. Speaking to people on the phone is part of the journey, join me!
Serving the needs of the community I grew up in has been a profound honor. People are fed up with David Schweikert and are ready for a change. Together, we are building a movement for change, and with your help, we will remove Schweikert this November.
Thank you for being a part of this journey. Your support, enthusiasm, and commitment drive this campaign forward. Let's stay engaged and make the changes we wish to see.

Check our campaign commercial! <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O6uvNkdKIjM>
Thank you,

Andrew Horne
480-256-9332[](http://voice.google.com/calls?a=nc,%2B14802569332 "Call +1 480-256-9332 via Google Voice")
[www.HorneForArizona.com](http://www.HorneForArizona.com)

body:
You may have heard I officially left the Democrat Party. I could no longer associate myself with the elitist, corrupt Party of Hillary Clinton, Joe Biden, and Nancy Pelosi.

| |

---
| | | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zvfar6mgefmhsciosshtftub0rfbt73cosavksug_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cti6eoj1c3h2bs "Tulsi Gabbard")
---

Hey, it's Tulsi Gabbard.

You might have heard - I left the Democrat Party.

I could no longer associate myself with the elitist cabal of "woke" warmongers led by Hillary Clinton, Joe Biden, and Kamala Harris. _**[In fact, I *literally* just wrote the book on why I left the Party that is:](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zk44pcmavjrt58616sav20dbrd4jjn80rt5lcle0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cti6eoj1c3h2bs "In fact, I *literally* just wrote the book on why I left the Party that is:")**_** **

- Weaponizing our own government against us
- Gutting the Second Amendment
- Erasing women and threatening fairness in women's sports
- Supporting the mutilation of children's bodies in the name of "gender affirming care"
- Censoring voices they do not approve of
- Enabling cartels and supporting illegal immigration
- Targeting people of faith and spirituality
- Pushing us toward WWIII and nuclear Armageddon
- Undermining free-speech

**The Democrat Party I joined over 20 years ago is dead and gone. **And the shell standing in its place is controlled by the most extreme power-hungry Democrat politicians and groups in America.

_**[I'm partnering with Steve Scalise for the FIRST TIME because our freedom and the future of our country hangs in the balance and we must do all we can to save it.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zoi5bnps21jc3v36fg7tlikbfdffr02kcg0cungg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cti6eoj1c3h2bs "I’m partnering with Steve Scalise for the FIRST TIME because our freedom and the future of our country hangs in the balance and we must do all we can to save it.")**_

We set a goal of raising 100K dollars by the end of the day TODAY. It's a big goal but those who stand for freedom are being outspent 10 to 1 by a Democrat Party that is eviscerating our Constitution and freedoms before our very eyes. We need an OVERWHELMING response to defeat those who are abusing their power once and for all.

_So with everything on the line in 2024, are you willing to step up when we need you the most?_
---
**[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z83pg975t364aucdnp3sp134cm0qrtegvo2728o8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cti6eoj1c3h2bs)[**YES >>**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zhte1c4qhd8n6gp9ad1lc1n3ad6el38hh7f3bh1o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cti6eoj1c3h2bs)_[**NO >>**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z2lh490hn654g1ak7ckgj8t1lj9hts1916q759tg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cti6eoj1c3h2bs)**
---
Aloha and God bless you.

- _Tulsi_

There's a tough question that I have to ask you on this fine day.

sponsor:

Dear
Friend,

There's a
tough question that I have to ask you on this fine day.

Here it
is...What is true about the world?

Tough,
right?

It's a
question mankind has asked since ancient times-since creation
itself. So, if you don't know the answer, that's fine (if you do,
email me because I would love to know more!).

This
question is especially pressing today because of the growing
power modern humans have to change and manipulate the material
world.

That's
one of the reasons we released our free online course, "The
Great Principles of Chemistry."

Why
chemistry?

For one,
this course brings a core subject studied at Hillsdale College to
millions of Americans, including you.

More
fundamentally, we study chemistry as part of our liberal arts
education at Hillsdale because the sciences help us understand
important aspects of reality. It helps us think about our role as
humans in the world around us and reveals the framework,
implications, and potential for human life.

Like all
our courses, "The Great Principles of Chemistry" contains
stunning visuals, study guides, quizzes, and in this case,
hands-on experiments. This content is especially well-suited for
science teachers, homeschool parents, or lifelong learners.

And our
online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity
of people like you to help us share the course with as many
people as possible.

Would you
consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this
course?

For any
donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box
set for "The Great Principles of Chemistry," by clicking the link
below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63379679:s4cCLYWBN:m:3:2627245898:BE40358C6098ECC6EAE23D3C08774FE8:r

The
proper study of chemistry helps us understand the world and
inspires wonder and awe at the beauty of creation and its
Creator.

For these
reasons, please join us in helping others gain a greater
appreciation for the world around us with "The Great Principles
of Chemistry."

Let's
promote what's true about our world together.

Warm
Regards,

Bill
Gray, '01

Hillsdale
College
