| |

---
| | | | [](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z9fid9ks0ulucmbu0h2rgsfmg03kd2fsm2rn9g2g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cti61p36cjh2bs "Tulsi Gabbard")
---

Hey, it's Tulsi Gabbard.

You might have heard - I left the Democrat Party.

I could no longer associate myself with the elitist cabal of "woke" warmongers led by Hillary Clinton, Joe Biden, and Kamala Harris. _**[In fact, I *literally* just wrote the book on why I left the Party that is:](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zdoodqhk3vhis66k376anabeb05f332vhtquia6g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cti61p36cjh2bs "In fact, I *literally* just wrote the book on why I left the Party that is:")**_** **

- Weaponizing our own government against us
- Gutting the Second Amendment
- Erasing women and threatening fairness in women's sports
- Supporting the mutilation of children's bodies in the name of "gender affirming care"
- Censoring voices they do not approve of
- Enabling cartels and supporting illegal immigration
- Targeting people of faith and spirituality
- Pushing us toward WWIII and nuclear Armageddon
- Undermining free-speech

**The Democrat Party I joined over 20 years ago is dead and gone. **And the shell standing in its place is controlled by the most extreme power-hungry Democrat politicians and groups in America.

_**[I'm partnering with Steve Scalise for the FIRST TIME because our freedom and the future of our country hangs in the balance and we must do all we can to save it.](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2znhimgb3q642k6jvgt7imgthsu17a0hoeafhpvro_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cti61p36cjh2bs "I’m partnering with Steve Scalise for the FIRST TIME because our freedom and the future of our country hangs in the balance and we must do all we can to save it.")**_

We set a goal of raising 100K dollars by the end of the day TODAY. It's a big goal but those who stand for freedom are being outspent 10 to 1 by a Democrat Party that is eviscerating our Constitution and freedoms before our very eyes. We need an OVERWHELMING response to defeat those who are abusing their power once and for all.

_So with everything on the line in 2024, are you willing to step up when we need you the most?_
---

- _Tulsi_

I’m grateful for the emergency responders who courageously stepped up – and today, I’m also thinking of Stephen Davoll of Barre City who passed due to the flooding. **As we commemorate the one year anniversary, I’m also dedicated to looking forward and turning tragedy into action.** Make no mistake – this disaster was a result of climate change. Climate action can’t wait, and the crisis of global warming requires an urgent, all-hands-on-deck approach. My promise to you is that I am fighting in Congress every day to take the bold and necessary steps to combat climate change and protect our state from future flooding. Natural disasters like the one we faced last year can be incredibly traumatic, which is why earlier this year I introduced the Mental Health Emergency Needs in Disasters (MEND) Act. Through my conversations with folks in the aftermath of the flooding, it became clear to me that mental health care is missing from federal disaster recovery programs. This act establishes a FEMA grant program to deploy mental health crisis units after a major disaster, providing professional counseling, peer support networks, and more. My hope is that by passing the MEND Act, Vermonters and folks across the country have access to mental health resources when they need it most. Peter, I am so proud of the way Vermonters have come together in the face of natural disasters. It is an honor to represent the Green Mountain State in Congress, and I’m committed to rebuilding a stronger, healthier Vermont together. – Becca

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
Josh Hawley’s latest bill lets members of Congress continue to get away with insider trading.
#
I’ve got a simple question for you, Peter.
**Why should the rules be harsher for you, me, and Martha Stewart than they are for members of Congress?**
Any one of us would get thrown in jail for insider trading. But instead of actually doing anything real to hold politicians accountable, Josh Hawley’s latest bill allows members of Congress to continue getting away with it.
All they have to do is pay a small fee on the _millions_ they make on the market.
**This year, I’m running to do more than just enact a real ban on insider trading for members of Congress, judges, and executive branch officials — I’m running to put them in jail if they steal from us.**
**[If you’re with me, will you please add a donation of any amount toward my campaign today? I’m not taking a single cent from corporate PACs, so I’m counting on your help to hold Josh Hawley accountable and get this message in front of Missouri voters before November 5th.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/55581?refcode=em20240711-5982&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5982%2E614464%2Ee3H4qz)**

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1639%2E135344%2EzYvEsP)

Friend --
In just a few days, we close the books on the last official FEC fundraising deadline before we know who our opponent will be in the November election.
This isn't one of those quarterly FEC deadlines we email about, but it is an official deadline -- and probably the most important of the campaign.
Here's why:
After July 17th, we're legally required to report what we've raised and how much money we have in the bank since our last deadline on June 30th. Same for our eventual opponent.
Our report will give super PACs a glimpse at the financial strength of our campaign just before we formally enter the general election, and they will use that information when deciding whether or not to run attack ads against us, or if they should move on to another race.
We want to file as strong a report as we possibly can, but with only 17 days between deadlines, that’s going to require a lot of support from a whole bunch of people giving whatever they can.
I wish we didn't have to make these requests this often via email, but the truth is it is where a majority of the donations we receive come from. So, I am asking:
[**Can I count on you to contribute $3 to my campaign for U.S. Senate in Michigan before the final FEC fundraising deadline of the primary campaign comes to a close in just a few days?**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24.5Fk0a0&refcode=em240711-1-800&t=2&akid=1639%2E135344%2EzYvEsP)

| | Dear Friend, In a time when free speech is increasingly controversial, the Hoover Institution's ebook, _Free Speech in America: Recognizing its Value, Boundaries, and Need for Protection,_ is an essential resource for understanding this fundamental right. We are excited to offer you this [comprehensive guide for free.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z76n1vhcr01l8juktl9hmsb62son5iioetfjahho_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cth60o74cjh2bs)
---
| | **Why is this ebook crucial now?**

Recent student protests on campuses across the nation have sparked intense debates about the limits and protections of free speech. At the same time, the rise of social media censorship and challenges to living out personal or religious convictions have made it more important than ever to understand the principles that underpin our right to free expression.**

In [_Free Speech in America,_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zl504ossspejjr0smkvkm42l312dst7femcorvk0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cth60o74cjh2bs) you'll find insightful research and analysis by five Hoover fellows who are experts in law, public policy, human rights, and civic education. This ebook provides clear, succinct answers to critical questions such as:

* What is freedom of speech?
* What kind of speech isn't protected, and where do we draw the line?
* How do private restrictions on free speech impact us?
* How can we effectively preserve this essential liberty?

This guide not only outlines the boundaries of free speech but also delves into its indispensable role in fostering a vibrant, innovative, and just society.

Whether you are concerned about the implications of social media censorship, the right to express your beliefs freely, or the broader cultural shifts challenging free expression, this ebook is your go-to resource.

**What's inside?**
* Analysis of campus free speech and their broader implications
* Discussions on the intersection of free speech and social media
* Insight into how free speech supports the exercise of personal and religious convictions
* Essays, interviews, and videos that provide deeper understanding and perspectives on these issues**
**

**Get Your Free Copy Now

**[Click here to download your copy of _Free Speech in America_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zt1egdauo3t9rce5cv29spt5h6sunafteot73vso_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cth60o74cjh2bs) and arm yourself with the knowledge to navigate and advocate for free speech in today's complex landscape.

Together, let's ensure that the freedom of speech remains a protected and cherished right for all.**
**
Best regards,
Greg Greg Stamps | Online Development Hoover Institution | Stanford University

| | America has an affordable housing crisis, and if we don't take action, it's going to get worse. One thing I'm doing about it is working to stop Wall Street hedge funds from driving up rents and home prices by outbidding regular folks with all-cash, no-inspection, over-the-asking-price offers. The 2008 housing crisis was fueled by predatory private mortgages and unregulated markets, and Wall Street hedge funds took advantage by gobbling up large portfolios of foreclosed homes. With the federal government facilitating this corporate greed through bulk sales of federally backed mortgages and foreclosed properties, ordinary families were shut out of recovering housing stability. **It was flat-out wrong.** All over the country, including right here in Oregon, hedge funds are wielding their financial muscle to snatch up available housing, outbid ordinary Americans, drive up prices and rents, and turn neighborhoods into Wall Street profit centers at the expense of folks struggling to find a place to call home. I'm tackling this problem with my _End Hedge Fund Control of American Homes Act_ to kick hedge funds out of the housing market and increase access to affordable housing. Here's what my legislation does: it bans hedge funds from owning single-family homes, forcing hedge funds and other large private investors to sell their inventory of single-family homes to families who don't currently own a home. And if the hedge funds don't, they are required to pay a substantial tax penalty that funds a down payment assistance program. We need to stop Wall Street from putting profits before people because everyone should have a safe, affordable place to call home. We're working to get it done! clean_body: Everyone should have a safe, affordable place to call home, and we’re working to get it done. | | | | America has an affordable housing crisis, and if we don't take action, it's going to get worse. One thing I'm doing about it is working to stop Wall Street hedge funds from driving up rents and home prices by outbidding regular folks with all-cash, no-inspection, over-the-asking-price offers. The 2008 housing crisis was fueled by predatory private mortgages and unregulated markets, and Wall Street hedge funds took advantage by gobbling up large portfolios of foreclosed homes. With the federal government facilitating this corporate greed through bulk sales of federally backed mortgages and foreclosed properties, ordinary families were shut out of recovering housing stability. It was flat-out wrong. All over the country, including right here in Oregon, hedge funds are wielding their financial muscle to snatch up available housing, outbid ordinary Americans, drive up prices and rents, and turn neighborhoods into Wall Street profit centers at the expense of folks struggling to find a place to call home. I'm tackling this problem with my End Hedge Fund Control of American Homes Act to kick hedge funds out of the housing market and increase access to affordable housing. Here's what my legislation does: it bans hedge funds from owning single-family homes, forcing hedge funds and other large private investors to sell their inventory of single-family homes to families who don't currently own a home. And if the hedge funds don't, they are required to pay a substantial tax penalty that funds a down payment assistance program. We need to stop Wall Street from putting profits before people because everyone should have a safe, affordable place to call home. We're working to get it done! Onward! | | Dear Friend, In a time when free speech is increasingly controversial, the Hoover Institution's ebook, _Free Speech in America: Recognizing its Value, Boundaries, and Need for Protection,_ is an essential resource for understanding this fundamental right. We are excited to offer you this [comprehensive guide for free.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjccfedcfrncqdt0nortuumgogm0bptavm2ic2no_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cth64or4c3h2bs)
---
| | **Why is this ebook crucial now?**

Recent student protests on campuses across the nation have sparked intense debates about the limits and protections of free speech. At the same time, the rise of social media censorship and challenges to living out personal or religious convictions have made it more important than ever to understand the principles that underpin our right to free expression.**

In [_Free Speech in America,_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0ouehoetg7tvp8mj9r8ffrku48up2m4q37hor60_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cth64or4c3h2bs) you'll find insightful research and analysis by five Hoover fellows who are experts in law, public policy, human rights, and civic education. This ebook provides clear, succinct answers to critical questions such as:

* What is freedom of speech?
* What kind of speech isn't protected, and where do we draw the line?
* How do private restrictions on free speech impact us?
* How can we effectively preserve this essential liberty?

This guide not only outlines the boundaries of free speech but also delves into its indispensable role in fostering a vibrant, innovative, and just society.

Whether you are concerned about the implications of social media censorship, the right to express your beliefs freely, or the broader cultural shifts challenging free expression, this ebook is your go-to resource.

**What's inside?**
* Analysis of campus free speech and their broader implications
* Discussions on the intersection of free speech and social media
* Insight into how free speech supports the exercise of personal and religious convictions
* Essays, interviews, and videos that provide deeper understanding and perspectives on these issues**
**

**Get Your Free Copy Now

**[Click here to download your copy of _Free Speech in America_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z85fid1qt28pql8em6vgju85glueon0jn7o3sj6o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cth64or4c3h2bs) and arm yourself with the knowledge to navigate and advocate for free speech in today's complex landscape.

Together, let's ensure that the freedom of speech remains a protected and cherished right for all.**
**
Best regards,
Greg Greg Stamps | Online Development Hoover Institution | Stanford University

Over more than one hundred years, Hoover’s work has directly led to policies that have produced greater freedom, democracy, and opportunity in the United States and around the world._

name: Team Evergreen
subject: Reflecting on 4️⃣ years of climate progress

body:
The Evergreen Action Plan charted the way forward in 2020, and we can do it again in 2024
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2686456/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Hi—

As we barrel toward November 2024, it's worth remembering where we were just four years ago.

While Donald Trump was presiding over a corrupt administration and eviscerating bedrock environmental protections, a smaller and scrappier version of Evergreen was turning Jay Inslee's "gold standard" climate policies into an open-source Action Plan with movement partners that laid out the comprehensive steps the next president needed to take to advance bold climate policy, rebuild the economy, and protect frontline communities.

Fast forward to the present day, and you might be surprised at just how much of that Evergreen Action Plan the Biden-Harris administration has made progress on.

**How much progress do you think the Biden-Harris administration has made on the Evergreen Action Plan's historic roadmap to climate action? Scroll through to the end—**[**and read our blog—to find out!**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2686457/87SdQ4wZ) 👇

We've come a long way in four years. We helped secure hundreds of billions of dollars in transformative investments through the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA). We helped share the strongest-ever climate and public health rules for the power sector. We helped establish the Justice40 initiative, directing 40% of clean energy investment benefits to frontline communities. And we helped create the American Climate Corps—just to a name a few things.

[**See how the Biden administration took note and delivered when the climate movement made clear demands.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2686458/87SdQ4wZ)

**The climate crisis remains before us, and soon America will face a choice:** the greatest climate administration in U.S. history, or the lying, convicted felon who is soliciting billions from Big Oil to reverse our progress.

Evergreen will be releasing a new Action Plan soon, where we map out the opportunities for continued climate leadership in a second Biden administration. It is a plan to avoid the worst of the climate crisis while unleashing new opportunities for everyday Americans—like lower costs, more good-paying jobs, and greater justice in the clean energy economy we all deserve.

And if you're wondering why we’re putting in all this effort (including working with partners and experts from across the climate and clean energy movement to make sure all of our recommendations are _just right_), [**consider just how much was accomplished the last time we set out a bold, actionable roadmap to a better shared future.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2686459/87SdQ4wZ)

In solidarity,

Team Evergreen |
---
|
* * *
**P.S.** The answer is that the Biden-Harris administration has made significant progress on **85 percent** of the policies Evergreen and our movement partners outlined in the original Evergreen Action Plan. That means a whopping 280 out of the 329 recommendations we made with movement partners are done or well on their way! [**Read more about this monumental progress here.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2686460/87SdQ4wZ) |

It was introduced by Georgia Congressman Andrew Clyde, who (surprise, surprise) operates two gun stores.
Representative Clyde and his fellow House Republicans who approved this amendment should be ashamed. This measure to roll back critical funding for research into our nation’s deadly gun violence crisis could lead to more gun-related deaths.

Dear Peter,
There has certainly been a lot of political drama these last couple weeks! The landscape, especially in the Democratic Party, is shifting rapidly, and it is likely to continue today with President Biden's first solo press conference of the year.
Robert F. Kennedy Jr. had planned to make an address to the nation today in Washington, DC. Because of the shifting landscape, the conclusion of the NATO summit, and President Biden's press conference, he has decided to wait until the air clears so that the public can pay attention to what he will say.
For now, here are some words from Mr. Kennedy that touch on one of the themes of his message:
"The turmoil in the Democratic Party, due to its nominating a candidate unfit for office, highlights the need for an alternative in this election. We are watching before our eyes the abject failure of two-party politics. But there is a way forward, and it does not involve the total defeat of one half of this country by the other. Remember, the haters are always the loudest. Underneath our political divisions, a broad majority of Americans share common hopes and values."
If you are one of those Americans, stay tuned to this channel!
Sincerely,
Team Kennedy

| If you haven’t heard already, I’m running for Congress in Michigan’s 8th district.

My story spans generations, and it begins right here in the heart of mid-Michigan, where I was born and raised.

I come from a long line of hardworking veterans and union workers. My father, a WWII bomber pilot turned GM worker, and my mother, a nurse with a long history of service, instilled in me strong values of hard work, resilience, and dedication.

Growing up, I was deeply inspired by my father and grandfathers, who put it all on the line for fair labor representation amidst the devastating impact of job loss in our community. My grandfathers, who were both original UAW members; my father, a veteran and UAW member; and my mother, a nurse who worked tirelessly at Hurley Medical Center in Flint, shaped my understanding of sacrifice, service, and the American Dream.

## Fish Tales: The Votes That Got Away

Dear Friends,

Funny thing: it turns out that if you skip work, the business of work keeps happening without you. And if the work you're skipping is representing Alaskans, Alaskans' voices don't get heard.

**Skipping Work to Go Fishing**
For most of us, skipping a week of work to go fishing would get us fired. But apparently, Mary Peltola thinks she's above that. During a crucial time when the House is in session, Mary decided it was more important to go fishing back in Alaska. Meanwhile, she’s pocketing $3,346.15 in salary from taxpayers this week alone. We’re all waiting for her to announce that she’s refunding that money to the U.S. Treasury because it’s ridiculous for her to get paid for a week she didn’t work.

To make matters worse, Mary says she'll submit statements to the Congressional Record about how she would have voted if she'd bothered to show up. Seriously? She thinks that saying, "Here's how I WOULD have done my job, if I had decided to do it" is good enough? Alaskans deserve better. We need someone who actually shows up and fights for us, not someone who mails in their votes after the fact.

**What's Happened While She’s Been Away**
While Mary’s been out fishing, some important things have been happening that show just how out of touch and inconsistent she is:

_Ambler Road Project_ : Mary can't seem to make up her mind about the Ambler Road project. First, she supported it, then wanted to pause it, then opposed Biden’s executive action stalling the project, and now she is in favor of pausing it again. Her House website still has a press release supporting Ambler, yet she claims she didn’t approve it. With one of the highest staff turnover rates in DC and a record of missing more votes than nearly every other member of Congress, it’s clear her office is a mess.

This seems like the sort of problem that could be resolved by her, say, actually being there? Instead, she's divided our delegation, sent mixed messages to those who can are making decisions that impact all Alaskans, and promptly skipped town to go fishing. Alaskans need a representative who knows what they’re doing and sticks to their word.

_SAVE Act_ : The SAVE Act is designed to secure federal elections and ensure only U.S. citizens can vote. This is an important bill to both Alaska and the country as a whole -- but instead of being in DC to support this critical bill, Mary’s off fishing. This says a lot about where her priorities lie. While she’s fishing, important legislation is being debated and decided without our voice.

Mary Peltola might think she can dodge accountability by hiding out in Alaska, but we won’t let her. We need a representative who is dedicated and actually does their job.

Thanks for sticking with us and keeping an eye on what’s going on. Together, we can make sure our voices are heard and our representatives are held to the highest standards. Mary can run, but she can't hide.

As your candidate for Congress, I promise to bring the dedication and work ethic that Alaska deserves. But I can't do it without you, and your support. Please [_**click here**_](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=b0bd92ee42&e=6679001ba0) to make a contribution. Your financial support is much-needed, greatly appreciated — and we'll put it to the best possible use: taking Alaska's seat back!

Thank you for your support.

Best regards,

Nick Begich

**PS**. The August primary is coming up quick! Make sure you **mark August 20th on the calendar** and make a plan to _**vote**_! NB

clean_body: Turns out that Congress does important stuff -- wish we were being represented ... | | | | | | | | Fish Tales: The Votes That Got Away Dear Friends, Funny thing: it turns out that if you skip work, the business of work keeps happening without you. And if the work you're skipping is representing Alaskans, Alaskans' voices don't get heard. Skipping Work to Go Fishing For most of us, skipping a week of work to go fishing would get us fired. But apparently, Mary Peltola thinks she's above that. During a crucial time when the House is in session, Mary decided it was more important to go fishing back in Alaska. Meanwhile, she’s pocketing $3,346.15 in salary from taxpayers this week alone. We’re all waiting for her to announce that she’s refunding that money to the U.S. Treasury because it’s ridiculous for her to get paid for a week she didn’t work. To make matters worse, Mary says she'll submit statements to the Congressional Record about how she would have voted if she'd bothered to show up. Seriously? She thinks that saying, "Here's how I WOULD have done my job, if I had decided to do it" is good enough? Alaskans deserve better. We need someone who actually shows up and fights for us, not someone who mails in their votes after the fact. What's Happened While She’s Been Away While Mary’s been out fishing, some important things have been happening that show just how out of touch and inconsistent she is: Ambler Road Project : Mary can't seem to make up her mind about the Ambler Road project. First, she supported it, then wanted to pause it, then opposed Biden’s executive action stalling the project, and now she is in favor of pausing it again. Her House website still has a press release supporting Ambler, yet she claims she didn’t approve it. With one of the highest staff turnover rates in DC and a record of missing more votes than nearly every other member of Congress, it’s clear her office is a mess. This seems like the sort of problem that could be resolved by her, say, actually being there? Instead, she's divided our delegation, sent mixed messages to those who can are making decisions that impact all Alaskans, and promptly skipped town to go fishing. Alaskans need a representative who knows what they’re doing and sticks to their word. SAVE Act : The SAVE Act is designed to secure federal elections and ensure only U.S. citizens can vote. This is an important bill to both Alaska and the country as a whole -- but instead of being in DC to support this critical bill, Mary’s off fishing. This says a lot about where her priorities lie. While she’s fishing, important legislation is being debated and decided without our voice. Mary Peltola might think she can dodge accountability by hiding out in Alaska, but we won’t let her. We need a representative who is dedicated and actually does their job. Thanks for sticking with us and keeping an eye on what’s going on. Together, we can make sure our voices are heard and our representatives are held to the highest standards. Mary can run, but she can't hide. As your candidate for Congress, I promise to bring the dedication and work ethic that Alaska deserves. But I can't do it without you, and your support. Please to make a contribution. Your financial support is much-needed, greatly appreciated — and we'll put it to the best possible use: taking Alaska's seat back! Thank you for your support. Best regards, Nick Begich PS. The August primary is coming up quick! Make sure you mark August 20th on the calendar and make a plan to vote! | | **Why is this ebook crucial now?**

Recent student protests on campuses across the nation have sparked intense debates about the limits and protections of free speech. At the same time, the rise of social media censorship and challenges to living out personal or religious convictions have made it more important than ever to understand the principles that underpin our right to free expression.**

In [_Free Speech in America,_](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z29272d55g3rvqpi11aff32vjdkj912a0jb9ekn0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cth62ob6cph2bs) you'll find insightful research and analysis by five Hoover fellows who are experts in law, public policy, human rights, and civic education. This ebook provides clear, succinct answers to critical questions such as:

* What is freedom of speech?
* What kind of speech isn't protected, and where do we draw the line?
* How do private restrictions on free speech impact us?
* How can we effectively preserve this essential liberty?

This guide not only outlines the boundaries of free speech but also delves into its indispensable role in fostering a vibrant, innovative, and just society.

Whether you are concerned about the implications of social media censorship, the right to express your beliefs freely, or the broader cultural shifts challenging free expression, this ebook is your go-to resource.

**What's inside?**
* Analysis of campus free speech and their broader implications
* Discussions on the intersection of free speech and social media
* Insight into how free speech supports the exercise of personal and religious convictions
* Essays, interviews, and videos that provide deeper understanding and perspectives on these issues**
**

**Get Your Free Copy Now

**[Click here to download your copy of _Free Speech in America_](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zli6an52tiq4btmfl9499f8q3fepp9hh599fe4so_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cth62ob6cph2bs) and arm yourself with the knowledge to navigate and advocate for free speech in today's complex landscape.

Together, let's ensure that the freedom of speech remains a protected and cherished right for all.**
**
Best regards,
Greg Greg Stamps | Online Development Hoover Institution | Stanford University

| | With one attack on democracy and established law after another over the past few weeks, it's worth a reminder of what we can do, where we hold power, and how to channel our rage into action. Here are some ways to record your dissent:
* **Practice good media literacy.**
Evaluate sources, biases, and conflicts of interest among news and media figures and publications. Don't take every headline at face value. Dig deeper.
* **Join a local protest or demonstration.**
Democracy is loud. Make your dedication to the cause known alongside your neighbors in a nonviolent way.
* **Check that your voter registration is current and up to date.**
[You can do that right here](https://click.everyaction.com/k/88697977/484835138/-1263008137?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTVAvMS85MjA2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YjYyMzYzOS05YTNmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_haCc1ostwO41ddUMvAckQ8cfGPvmx6sZY29QhrfB5Q=&emci=2f2f0986-f63e-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=8b623639-9a3f-ef11-86d2-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=5534179).

Everyone knows the presidential race is on the ballot this year, but so are lots of other issues! Your state may be voting to protect abortion rights, legalize marijuana, or raise the wage for our working brothers, sisters, and neighbors.

Pick a race you care about and jump in! Want to volunteer with an organization like ours working on the ground to put power back in the hands of the people? We need you!
* **Think...small?**
You can help uphold democracy from the city level and up. Does your county prosecutor refuse to prosecute women seeking abortions? Do your county Board of Elections commissioners pledge to certify the results of the election? Local races matter.

Friends,

I thought I'd take a second to tell you how I got here – a United States Senator for the great state of Ohio. body:

What do you think of the Electoral College?

Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its
National Referendum on the Administrative State.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWZQ7mYWN8

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

Hillsdale College has selected you to
participate in its National Referendum on the Administrative
State.

Responding will only take a few
minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right
away…because our country is facing a constitutional
crisis.

It's a crisis that involves a
fundamental political question: who rules whom?

The Constitution established a limited
government in which the people ruled through their elected
officials. Under this form of government, America became the
freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional
system is one that increasingly exists in name only.

The Constitution of "We the People" is
being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable
administrative state that rules without the consent of American
citizens.

This means we live in an era of growing
bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state
that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers,
and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

But we can't just TALK about the
problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION-to DO SOMETHING about it,
while there's still time to save our country.

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to
returning to the Constitution of "We the People"-before it's too
late.

To do that, I need your input. What are
your opinions on this topic-knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS
that will restore liberty?

Please let me know your thoughts today
by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State
using this secure link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63379794:WZQ7mYWN8:m:3:2532013465:B6D63E3C7F0974EDBA5B5C62A1BE31F6:r

When you send in your survey, I hope
you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a
tax-deductible gift.

The rise of the administrative state is
a grave threat to our country.

To counter this threat, Hillsdale
sponsors several educational outreach efforts-including Imprimis,
free online courses, programs on our Washington, D.C., campus,
and a growing network of classical K-12 schools and
homeschoolers-to teach citizens about the meaning of the
Constitution and the importance of our founding principles of
liberty.

Your gift of at least $15-or even $25,
$35, $50, $100, or more if you're especially motivated to TAKE
ACTION-will help us to expand these educational initiatives that
are reaching and teaching millions.

Your support of these efforts is
essential because Hillsdale refuses to take ONE PENNY of
government funding.

So please complete your National
Referendum on the Administrative State and consider giving your
most generous tax-deductible contribution.

Thank you for being on the side of the
Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty
Since 1844

P.S. I look forward to receiving your
opinions about what's happening in our nation. And I hope that
you can support our work.

So please complete the National
Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63379794:WZQ7mYWN8:m:3:2532013465:B6D63E3C7F0974EDBA5B5C62A1BE31F6:r

As soon as you respond, we will begin
your FREE lifetime subscription to Imprimis, Hillsdale's digest
of liberty that you will receive via email ten times a year. If
you'd like, you can also sign up to receive the publication
through postal mail.

Educating millions about the
Constitution to counter the threat from the administrative state
is a monumental task. That's why when you complete your survey, I
hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a
tax-deductible gift.

Thank you for your time and
attention-and for your commitment to liberty.

body:
Last month, Republican megadonors ousted Jamaal Bowman from office, thanks to the $17 million that AIPAC and their MAGA funders spent in the race. | | | Peter, Last month, Republican megadonors ousted Jamaal Bowman from office, thanks in large part to the $17 million that AIPAC and their MAGA funders spent in the race. It was a bitter pill to swallow. body:

| | | Dear Friends: As we find ourselves halfway through the summer, we are excited to share the latest updates from Solidarity Strategies with you. With the intensity of an election year upon us, our team has been busy and working hard to support our clients across the country. Check out what we were up to during the month of June:

| |

Founder, **Chuck Rocha** attended The NALEO Education Fund Annual Conference in Las Vegas and spoke on a panel with political strategist **Mike Madrid** and Telemundo's **Nicole Suárez**. ICYMI, you can watch this exclusive live recording of****_The Latino Vote Podcast[here.](https://solidaritystrategies.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=985fddf6f660c0281e297f819&id=0b4042a9a0&e=b8f90417f9)_

| |

**Solidarity Partner, Luis attended an event celebrating the 12th anniversary of DACA hosted by the White House.**

Last month, the**** Biden-Harris Administration announced an executive order that will provide new protections to certain spouses of U.S. citizens and streamline access to work visas for DACA recipients. Read more about it [_here_](https://solidaritystrategies.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=985fddf6f660c0281e297f819&id=bdce445439&e=b8f90417f9).

---
| |

U.S. Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez secured the majority vote in the primary elections, paving the way for her fourth term representing New York's 14th Congressional District.

subject: Help me hit a home run
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the NRSC
body:
Friend,

It's official. We are through game one of the double header.

The voters have spoken, and they chose me to be the Republican candidate for Senate in California.

That means you and I will have just eight months to build a 58-county, grassroots campaign capable of defeating Adam Schiff - with his _ActBlue_ allies and the war chest he's assembled during the two decades he spent in Washington, D.C.

**[That is why I'm humbly asking you to rush an emergency $30 contribution to my campaign today.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=88ed6fd3d88d46ceb9142c7e318cfd31&_e=hddCC0gFpBE6gUPZ21opX8OtUZeRzu1PsEZwiGpDkA7chgSBpQkQwznbuw7NLGFRIQnDqrluSbVtbDEA52yYy4gPKdxnf0BEXujCFta-AJBdBbpGkyG93FQ4Aah7vXMaPMiw6yYi6jAMwe7dsVbC-D4nHqdI3OpPYPZYzXHCDPOmkjoPNXuQ4A3dbzqmdJSopd8dog5O4bZcreE4fSnPxIRhEpoZyJA1_TfQGpC2cu5POQ8kMD-sULV4PgWlawGAnem1LHD89MWSA5W5ldpThMrP39Pi8kKjG80mjT88jf9Zk1murUaILhCN_dpk4HZGgQTOBM33rHZvCBwaK0gDOVP97zTqgA9bTb4sDy8qMosQiNAa5kG_mh9jo9fcsAQxC2q4VuzHNp44l4zBoCGZ_hmcSppDWyLXsEY_Sau1NVfDimwd3tqQhFV2HOTp--VGZnN9PqFhvFrgt85A33jKLB_jMrBwSuX3v_01o-AFCwO0lNlrj-FrEH63n5Xid3Oo)**

There's no time to lose. With every day that goes by, you and I are getting more and more reminders why it's so important we win this election.
The reality is present-day America is starting to look a lot like 1970s America. You remember what it was like:
* Not only were gas prices sky high, Carter's rationing meant we could only buy gas on even or odd days depending on our license plate numbers. Remember?

* Eleven Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village in Munich by terrorists. Remember?

* Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists in Iran. Remember? Democrat policies had brought America to its knees.

**How Many of you believe that ONLY US Citizens should vote?**
**Well I DO** - _**Jim Himes Does not**_. That is one of the basic foundations of our Democracy.
[Pledge your support](https://substack..-TwOyyi5v_N7lWGs5xDUphUE5gCzG2CiSls910hGfko?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=146511289)

Yesterday, the US House passed the S.A.V.E. Act (Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act), also known as HR 8281. The bill passed 221-198 by the US House of Representatives and **REQUIRES** individuals to provide documentary proof of US citizenship in order to register to vote in federal elections.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b5a33315-a781-4226-94fb-b3bd145b7078?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

**What a novel concept. Not Really - it is as old as our democracy.**
**GUESS WHO** voted against this critical safeguard to election integrity - _**Our Congressman Jim Himes and the entire Connecticut cohort of Democrats**_ Do Not CARE about you or election integrity. Let the record show:
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/9dfd9e11-ba9a-4da0-9f8a-cbdcbc10dfb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
(source: [Office of the Clerk, US House of Representatives](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c11e541b-347a-43eb-ba1f-31cba9a8132e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
Jim Himes is OK with Non-US citizens voting. **These are groups that include gang members, terrorists, criminals, sex and human traffickers.** They also include anyone who wants to come to live in America just for benefits, including free housing, free food, clothing, free education for kids and spending allowances. **This is another abandonment of the working class.**
**WHAT ABOUT US - The Tax Paying Legal Citizens of the US?** How in the world can we have a country where illegals are allowed to vote? The name of the act is great but who CARES about US? Well I Care.
Jim's vote against the CARE Act demonstrates that Jim needs votes wherever they come from. He is after all [Sandinista Jim and here is my Article on his glorification of the Sandinistas and their Marxist/Communist view](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1b0e82fd-5a7d-4d0a-9ddf-cebb994dbac6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). He also thought it was a good idea to bring those in from Gaza that could have ties to Hamas (assuming they could be vetted). [See my previous article on Hamas and Himes](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/aead328c-ac4a-4314-9e8f-09fe6c8d8d26?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Somebody that is willing to vote against the bill that requires proof of citizenship to vote in our elections should not be re-elected to represent YOU. As Bridgeport and other cities are being investigated for the ballot-box improprieties that have been going on for decades, this is the new playbook to try to get new "voters" or buy new voters with benefits, inundate the cities for the 2030 census and re-district us from ever being able to win another election.
**Well the time is NOW**. I am running against Jim Himes. I am in a primary August 13. I need your support and I need your support **NOW** so that I can replace Jim Himes and restore election integrity in our country again.
**MAKE YOUR VOICES HEARD ON AUGUST 13th BY GOING TO THE POLLS.**

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to read this CONSERVATIVE NEWS ALERT:
Angry, Bitter Don Tracy Meddling in IL GOP Chairman’s Race as SSC Rushes Selection to Appoint New State Party Chair (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/angry-bitter-don-tracy-meddling-in-il-gop-chairmans-race-as-ssc-rushes-selection-to-appoint-new-state-party-chair.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=a9dbfe76fd-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Illinois Republican Party Chairman Don Tracy at the Illinois State Fair GOP rally in 2023. (Photo: Chicago Tribune)

By Illinois Review
With the Republican National Convention just days away, the Illinois Republican State Central Committee is moving at warp speed to appoint a new state party chairman as Republicans across the state raise concerns about the vetting process and the need for transparency as candidates jockey to be the next leader of the Illinois Republican Party.

On Wednesday evening, three candidates submitted their applications for party chairman: Aaron Del Mar, John Cabello and Kathy Salvi – but it’s Salvi – the former GOP nominee for U.S. Senate that’s creating the most buzz amongst grassroots circles. For the last two years, Salvi has defended outgoing chairman Don Tracy, co-hosted state party fundraisers with Tracy, and was endorsed by gubernatorial candidate Richard Irvin during the 2022 election cycle. Irvin was the state party’s favorite candidate – and Tracy’s too, although he won’t admit it – during the 2022 primary, but lost in a landslide to the conservative grassroots-backed candidate by 43 points. name: Tom Fitton
subject: FWD What is Joe Biden Trying to Hide Now?
body:
This is a very serious and urgent matter, so please hear me out. Joe Biden and his administration are stonewalling Judicial Watch over the release of critical public documents directly related to the president's possible criminal liability for the unauthorized removal, retention and disclosure of classified documents after he left office as vice-president in 2017.

| Dear Fellow American,

Well, after the presidential debate on June 27th, I think we know the answer to the question "what is Joe Biden trying to hide?"

But I am not here to talk about that debate, or the controversies raging over the president's health and political future.

What I want you to know is that Judicial Watch will keep fighting through the courts for the release of Joe Biden's February Special Counsel audio interviews...for the simple reason that the American people have a right to hear them!

Thanks to you, Judicial Watch is America's largest open records litigator. We are committed to breaking through government secrecy so that Americans can read (and hear) public records to help them know what their government, and its leaders, are up to.

Our work for transparency in government never stops, and it has never been more important.

**[And that's why I hope you can support us with a special contribution today.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69051&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)**

Thank you,

Tom Fitton
President

| Dear Fellow American,

This is a very serious and urgent matter, so please hear me out.
Joe Biden and his administration are stonewalling **Judicial Watch** over the release of critical public documents directly related to the president's possible criminal liability for the unauthorized removal, retention and disclosure of classified documents after he left office as vice-president in 2017.
We are fighting back with every legal tool we have...but [**we need your help!**](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69051&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69051&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

You may recall, Special Counsel Robert Hur taped recordings of Biden's interviews with prosecutors earlier this year...and later, in his official report, Hur famously called Biden a "well-meaning, elderly man with a poor memory" and declined to charge the president with a "serious felony."

**_Judicial Watch_** _believes the American people have a right to hear these tapes_ , and make up their own minds about Joe Biden's testimony and his credibility....because "no one is above the law," including the President of the United States.

And at **Judicial Watch,** we also believe in _one standard of justice applied to all_!

That's why we sued the Justice Department back in March, after they failed to respond to our Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request for those audio records.

**[And that's why I am asking you to give us your support today.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69051&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)**

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69051&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

Just last week the Justice Department told us that they would not release the two audio tapes because they would constitute a "clearly unwarranted invasion of personal privacy."

I believe that the public's right to know about Joe Biden's actions related to the documents he removed the from the White House outweighs his privacy in this case, _and we will go the legal distance to force the release of records from the Special Counsel's investigation!_

Of course, that costs money.

It's easy to complain about Joe Biden's efforts to hide documents and audio recordings from the American people that "we the people" have a right to see and hear...

_But where others complain,**Judicial Watch** acts_!

[I deeply hope you will help us with a contribution now](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69051&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2), so that we can keep the legal pressure on, in this lawsuit and in all our lawsuits fighting against public corruption and for transparency in government.

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69051&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

Thank you in advance for giving us your support today!

Sincerely,

Thomas Fitton

| **Modesto Police Officers’ Association Endorses Congressman John Duarte**
---
| | **Modesto, CA** — Today, the Modesto Police Officers’ Association has endorsed Congressman John Duarte’s re-election. This endorsement highlights Duarte’s ability to set aside partisan politics to protect the officers in uniform and stop the rising crime across California.

“I am thankful for the trust placed in me by the sworn men and women of the Modesto Police Officers’ Association,” said John Duarte. “Their relentless efforts make Modesto a safer city to live, work, and raise a family. I’ll continue fighting so they and other first responders have the resources to keep our communities safe.”

The Modesto Police Officers’ Association joins a growing list of public safety leaders supporting Duarte’s candidacy, including the Peace Officers Research Association of California, the International Union of Police Associations, Turlock Associated Police Officers, and Sheriff John Zanoni.

For more information about John Duarte and his campaign, please visit www.JohnDuarteforCongress.com.

| | **Why is this ebook crucial now?**

Recent student protests on campuses across the nation have sparked intense debates about the limits and protections of free speech. At the same time, the rise of social media censorship and challenges to living out personal or religious convictions have made it more important than ever to understand the principles that underpin our right to free expression.**

In [_Free Speech in America,_](https://email.republicanmajority.net/c/eJyMkMGOpCAQhp8GbxooUPTAoRPjrTubveyRIJbKRsAg9mTefmJ6OpnjXOv_89VX9e-u78ZtLiwP41Elr9Ohg9FrjE9M5ZwQy2NHtKsGCqKksmRMQzGppgPZsgIVk0AlCMGhWJWc-TQzM_K6o83cdlxMM207AbbldpqhcOriUMkYk6Kum6qGTo6CW0OlsHIeiaAJ93PcnDXBm_8xufxZBczFptac94PwG4GBwJDwiGeyeFQv2yqmhcDww_nq8eHMXr-ahPd7iseONruwEGiuyOPkTk94j9647Xtojd-NWwLh_cV7415ZDBlDJrx_PPSfW_n3Xr5vItDEzRLe85Z3XZHUtH-4bXNHI4mgy7WgstEX-feffir4CgAA__-dhob0) you'll find insightful research and analysis by five Hoover fellows who are experts in law, public policy, human rights, and civic education. This ebook provides clear, succinct answers to critical questions such as:

* What is freedom of speech?
* What kind of speech isn't protected, and where do we draw the line?
* How do private restrictions on free speech impact us?
* How can we effectively preserve this essential liberty?

This guide not only outlines the boundaries of free speech but also delves into its indispensable role in fostering a vibrant, innovative, and just society.

Whether you are concerned about the implications of social media censorship, the right to express your beliefs freely, or the broader cultural shifts challenging free expression, this ebook is your go-to resource.

**What's inside?**
* Analysis of campus free speech and their broader implications
* Discussions on the intersection of free speech and social media
* Insight into how free speech supports the exercise of personal and religious convictions
* Essays, interviews, and videos that provide deeper understanding and perspectives on these issues**
**

**Get Your Free Copy Now

**[Click here to download your copy of _Free Speech in America_](https://email.republicanmajority.net/c/eJyMkMGOpCAQhp8GbxooUPTAoRPjrTubveyRIJbKRsAg9mTefmJ6OpnjXOv_89VX9e-u78ZtLiwP41Elr9Ohg9FrjE9M5ZwQy2NHtKsGCqKksmRMQzGppgPZsgIVk0AlCMGhWJWc-TQzM_K6o83cdlxMM207AbbldpqhcOriUMkYk6Kum6qGTo6CW0OlsHIeiaAJ93PcnDXBm_8xufxZBczFptac94PwG4GBwJDwiGeyeFQv2yqmhcDww_nq8eHMXr-ahPd7iseONruwEGiuyOPkTk94j9647Xtojd-NWwLh_cV7415ZDBlDJrx_PPSfW_n3Xr5vItDEzRLe85Z3XZHUtH-4bXNHI4mgy7WgstEX-feffir4CgAA__-dhob0) and arm yourself with the knowledge to navigate and advocate for free speech in today's complex landscape.

Together, let's ensure that the freedom of speech remains a protected and cherished right for all.**
**
Best regards,
Greg Greg Stamps | Online Development Hoover Institution | Stanford University

Friends,
It is a sad day for the American justice system...
Today was supposed to be the day that Donald Trump was sentenced for the 34 federal crimes he was found guilty of committing.
But thanks to the conservative Supreme Court and their recent immunity decision – Trump’s sentencing has been delayed until September 18th.
This gives him yet another chance to wriggle out of facing justice.
To recap – the court ruled that Donald Trump has partial immunity for his official acts as President.
This effectively excused his role in provoking violence leading up to Jan. 6 and has complicated his sentencing in his FEC campaign violation hush money conviction.
This dangerous precedent threatens the very foundation of our Constitution and effectively makes presidents into kings – and it’s up to us to fight back.
Defeating ULTRA-MAGA Republicans, like my opponent Jim Jordan, this November is now more important than ever.
I’m running for Congress to stand up to Trump and his cronies and tell them no one is above the rule of law.
Jordan, as Chair of the House Judiciary Committee, has weaponized his power to shield Trump from accountability while relentlessly pursuing Trump’s political opponents.
He has proven time and again that he will put party loyalty and extremist agendas over his oath of office, the Constitution, and the needs of our community.
I have dedicated my life to advocating for the marginalized and fighting for justice and equality. Growing up in a financially challenged home, I have overcome situations that fuel my commitment to helping others. If you want a leader who truly understands the struggles of working people and will always prioritize the needs of families, join our fight to take down Jim Jordan. I believe we need a government that works for the people, not for the whims of a federally convicted authoritarian leader.
Unlike Jim Jordan, I will hold those in power accountable and work tirelessly to protect our democracy.
I will champion federal protection for women’s rights and fight for a fair economy where one job is enough to live a good life.
I am committed to empowering everyday Americans, especially veterans, disabled individuals, minorities, and children, ensuring they receive the support and opportunities they deserve.
We are at a crossroads, and the stakes could not be higher. Every day, the fight for the heart and soul of our nation grows more intense.
We face unprecedented challenges to our voting rights, reproductive freedoms, and the sanctity of free and fair elections.
Amid this turmoil, I hold steadfast to one truth: America’s strong women will save our democracy.
It’s time to energize, organize, and defeat ULTRA-MAGA extremism this fall. Will you stand with me in this fight? subject: Former Speaker Pelosi’s battle with the New York Times
body:
Pelosi said, “I don’t know what’s happened in New York Times that they make up news.”

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88709805/484877951/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDA3YmQ4OWItYWYzZi1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=t-HjKAhoT8zakKUagnnClh-7EpjzQjxlCCvsLqoNeUI=&emci=f0737e95-af3f-ef11-86d2-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=407bd89b-af3f-ef11-86d2-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
The _New York Times_ coverage of Joe Biden is making news again for all the wrong reasons and Nancy Pelosi isn’t having it.
In case you missed it, Pelosi appeared on _MSNBC_ ’s _Morning Joe_ and, when asked about President Biden’s decision to stay in the presidential race, she had this to say:
**"I want [Biden] to do whatever he decides to do, and that’s — that’s the way it is. Whatever he decides, we go with."**
Bafflingly, here’s how the _Times_ covered that statement:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88709809/484877954/-593472309?refcode=20240711-EM-PelosiNYT&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDA3YmQ4OWItYWYzZi1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=t-HjKAhoT8zakKUagnnClh-7EpjzQjxlCCvsLqoNeUI=)
**Former Speaker Pelosi quickly corrected the record, telling _CBS_ that the _Times_ misrepresented what she said, adding “I don’t know what’s happened in _New York Times_ that they make up news.”**
[**We’ll talk more about the _Times_ ’ bias against Biden in a second, but if you support COURIER’s mission to call out misinformation in the media, can you chip in $20 now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88709810/484877960/-593472309?refcode=20240711-EM-PelosiNYT&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDA3YmQ4OWItYWYzZi1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=t-HjKAhoT8zakKUagnnClh-7EpjzQjxlCCvsLqoNeUI=)
Peter, this isn’t the first time the _Times_ has been accused of bias against Biden. Only two weeks ago, they penned an op-ed themselves calling for President Biden to drop out:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88709811/484877961/-593472309?refcode=20240711-EM-PelosiNYT&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDA3YmQ4OWItYWYzZi1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=t-HjKAhoT8zakKUagnnClh-7EpjzQjxlCCvsLqoNeUI=)
Notably, when Trump was convicted of 34 felonies, they instead claimed that voters should decide _his_ fate. 🙄
And it’s not just in the opinion section: remember how the _Times_ ran this hero shot on their front page when Trump pleaded not-guilty plea to charges that he endangered national security by flagrantly mishandling classified documents?

They will be our last line of defense in our work to protect the fundamental values we all care about — including reproductive rights, women’s rights, LGBTQ+ rights, our fight to combat systemic racism, and more. Earlier this week, Josh Hawley proudly announced that he's "advocating Christian nationalism." The clip went viral. If you haven't already seen it, watch for yourself:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/da3409d8-3e04-4385-a105-9a21b1ea899c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Josh Hawley doesn't love our country. He hates the freedom it was founded on.
**He is simply not like us. **
Instead of fighting for the freedoms he took an oath to protect, Hawley has been on a crusade to put Big Brother elites like himself in charge of what happens in your bedroom, your doctor's office, your workplace, your marriage, and even your own body.
It's creepy. It's weird. And it sure as hell isn't his job.
So while most people probably couldn't even tell you what "Christian nationalism" means, here's how Josh Hawley has spent six years demonstrating what it means to him:
* **[Outlawing virtually all abortions nationwide;](https://substack.com/redirect/4b619a77-d450-4705-8e46-c1bf4a68326c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* **[No federal protections for IVF;](https://substack.com/redirect/15553664-d639-450f-a797-c37df1b34da7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* **[No federal protections for contraception;](https://substack.com/redirect/c1c657bc-0464-404d-8706-b166823672e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **
* **[No protections for essentially any reproductive healthcare;](https://substack.com/redirect/67432d62-2428-4d39-8963-4e7312daf973?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Bottom line: Trump will raise prices, cause inflation, and strip Americans of their hard-earned money. This is what’s at stake this November.
|
---
Friend,

I’m sure you’ve heard of “Project 2025,” the proposed governing agenda for a second Donald Trump term. Some of their most over-the-top proposals are getting tons of coverage, like abolishing the independence of agencies like the FBI, firing tens of thousands of civil servants in place of loyalists, and giving Trump the power to operate as an unchecked dictator. But there’s one portion that isn’t getting nearly enough attention: **economic policy**. They propose:
* Returning to the gold standard, which would be catastrophic and destabilize the global economy.
* Drastically increasing tariffs, raising huge taxes on all American consumers.
* Eliminating visas for most agricultural workers, creating a giant hole in the workforce, and increasing prices on American-grown food.

Don’t just take it from me—16 Nobel Prize-winning economists warn that Trump’s economic plans will lead to **rampant inflation.** I’m an old-school conservative. I believe in the power of free enterprise, and that walling ourselves off from global markets would be an absolute disaster. It breaks my heart that Donald Trump has turned the party of Reagan into one that pushes economically illiterate policies. **Bottom line: Trump will raise prices, increase inflation, and strip Americans of their hard-earned money.** This is what’s at stake this November. It will happen if we don’t beat Trump at the ballot box. [And we need your help to do it](https://cQ0qs04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/2L+113/cQ0qs04/VWVt851YBlCmW3PB1QC9lXtNrV3Z50p5hnTm3N8LB06F3m2ndW6N1vHY6lZ3kzW3s9D5h7ZpRS1W5rCm222pQFfpW4yJ_5v6zPzX5W4P-LxD7-18bgW2-hNmW1NmgRCW8WbMdM5WDdXwW4NDYbC2xnWMRW354rW_21vTF6VY0-pt87BZlQW3ZQYB83-R4cGN686pv9JNk1zW70gFMW2tSKPRW2kXgzY4vT5MjW1CdMqN8shfb3W81YPs42j9HMcW2gS31z6-RVDHW8RXd-T5jCTBfW50vdp62yrn8vW65tCdl1cSl_NW1hVWfK2bxN1cW7NJXrJ4c6J41Vy4dJ389Fvq5f7d2Yx004). body:
**[_Peter, President Obama just broke his silence and issued a dire warning to every last one of us to tell us the stakes in this historic election. Barack knows Trump just raked in $331 MILLION in the last three months – and he knows it’s going to take all of us banding together to catch up with his massive cash haul. Supporting President Biden in PA and Across the Country
Friend,
Kennedy Democrats is holding firm in our support for President Biden - the stakes are too high. Since our founding in 2018, we’re committed to our belief in our Democratic principles and know Joe Biden has embodied these principles throughout his term. This support, and these beliefs, continue today and will continue through November.
Kennedy Democrats have been working on the ground in Pennsylvania and across the country to support President Biden in his re-election campaign. In fact, former President Donald Trump decided to insult our Co-Founder Patrick Murphy after he defended President Biden's record of delivering for the American people on national television. As always, Patrick handled it with grace and class.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP25/1/106220/images/Trump.jpg]
Suffice to say, the stakes in this election are massive, and we cannot win without your help. Pennsylvania is THE battleground state in this election. Your support, your vote, and your voice will determine the outcome of this election. Whether it’s through a contribution, a comment, or simply a discussion at this kitchen table we must make our voices heard.
We would love if you could join us Congresswoman Madeleine Dean, State Rep. Patty Kim, and candidate Anna Payne on July 25th. The link to RSVP is below. We hope to see you there!

Hi Friend,

**_I haven't introduced myself in a while, and I want you to know why I believe what I do._**

I spent my childhood in Middletown, Ohio, in a working-class family. I didn't have all the glamor that most people in politics have growing up; let me tell you, there were no silver spoons in our household.

I was raised by my Mamaw and Papaw, and they taught me the nobility of hard work.

In my hometown, I saw my friend's parents hard at work in the factories. These same manufacturing jobs are now in danger of being ripped from our grasp because of China and bad trade deals absolutely destroying the manufacturing sector.

Washington Elites have failed at protecting most Americans. Career politicians are focused on big dollar donors, focused on pleasing their friends, and pushing their own swampy agendas. **They've never cared about taxing your small businesses, protecting your rights, or preventing the crises facing middle America.**

This is why I knew I had to run for office. I was determined to stand up to this record of failure and fight for working Americans. I'm looking out for the Americans like the ones I grew up with, the ones left behind by those who promised to look out for them.

It's the honor of a lifetime to serve this great country and the Buckeye State, but I can't keep doing it without your support.

JD Vance

clean_body: I haven't told you this in a while | Hi Friend, I haven't introduced myself in a while, and I want you to know why I believe what I do. I spent my childhood in Middletown, Ohio, in a working-class family. I didn't have all the glamor that most people in politics have growing up; let me tell you, there were no silver spoons in our household. I was raised by my Mamaw and Papaw, and they taught me the nobility of hard work. In my hometown, I saw my friend's parents hard at work in the factories. These same manufacturing jobs are now in danger of being ripped from our grasp because of China and bad trade deals absolutely destroying the manufacturing sector. Washington Elites have failed at protecting most Americans. Career politicians are focused on big dollar donors, focused on pleasing their friends, and pushing their own swampy agendas. They've never cared about taxing your small businesses, protecting your rights, or preventing the crises facing middle America. This is why I knew I had to run for office. I was determined to stand up to this record of failure and fight for working Americans. I'm looking out for the Americans like the ones I grew up with, the ones left behind by those who promised to look out for them. It's the honor of a lifetime to serve this great country and the Buckeye State, but I can't keep doing it without your support. | Thank you, JD Vance Conservative Outsider. Marine. Businessman. Author. Ohio needs a true conservative in the U.S. Senate. It needs someone who understands how our economic and government leaders conspire to make life harder for normal Americans.
