* * *
Jen O’Malley Dillon here, Campaign Chair on Team Biden-Harris. In the wake of last month’s debate, many of you have asked for an update on the path ahead and what we need to do to work together to defeat Donald Trump. Going into the debate, our campaign was clear-eyed about the five things we needed to do to win this race:
1. Showing the strength of the President’s record of accomplishment, leadership, and support.

2. Going on the offense against Trump to draw contrast and show how dangerous another term would be.
3. Maintaining multiple pathways to 270 electoral votes, with a focus on the Blue Wall states.
4. Staying laser-focused on our coalition of voters and double-down on our grassroots support.
5. Driving a vision and ambitious agenda for the future.

Those imperatives remain true. What has changed following the debate is the urgency and discipline with which we need to pursue them. _We believe if we follow the roadmap below, we will win._ So, I hope you’ll take a second to read it. [ And, if you’re ready to donate now to help Joe and Kamala on our Path to Victory you can chip in $25 right now.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.NV3IV8RXB3BPG-RgoenRivizIuY7_hyRTlr0Ev1A4jwo48Pzlh6he5y-OY0IheoZAHBYtwOYq1P-51xWiyivVReMFTOLEW2nxxLbAprslarArWUJjLLrrWBSH_UEYAJWFexiBuCnMhvjUno6gmsWWtLqhzayEGg92zXN_3c-scgHQmubIYZC2oTSfVHdu1v8OWBqG-etkP8FVOgkU9xojMW9lYwhJpXhpjNH5nuo3LJO2q82jv5fM17S0kfz53SX_JBCBkucr6awdlmKLz3AOP0nSymvW_sn_tTNuHDs4rcvi5dEB_jkL4vRlWFviO4laXhCF6fl0NcogdGnMiekvvT-SpHCYdh4NDAqOAFN7JX4QHhn5_ggDrL3qR1Cq84OPvIyyxDQfLXbVjp4GZK9JeSWRSMh5-0IsAX4LqMOjZHebFQMJ7zh0TlyVMnWoNZtnblq4KX-LECieaKHt9-_y8zDBv3BZf-Vc5YAgNiQsNhvd7Tv-NKDZOQ2jfpA8kxanTFhMHXp2gIn6nBsTsWUeA/47y/BBBSPpuMTgOKB45ZnSfQtw/h1/h001.TomqG7BJnD1FQS7ti9oIXmN2YwBEDuuvsSeKcqkPzIs) | | | [DONATE NOW](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.NV3IV8RXB3BPG-RgoenRivizIuY7_hyRTlr0Ev1A4jwo48Pzlh6he5y-OY0IheoZAHBYtwOYq1P-51xWiyivVReMFTOLEW2nxxLbAprslarArWUJjLLrrWBSH_UEYAJWFexiBuCnMhvjUno6gmsWWtLqhzayEGg92zXN_3c-scgHQmubIYZC2oTSfVHdu1v8OWBqG-etkP8FVOgkU9xojMW9lYwhJpXhpjNH5nuo3LJO2q82jv5fM17S0kfz53SX_JBCBkucr6awdlmKLz3AOP0nSymvW_sn_tTNuHDs4rcvi5dEB_jkL4vRlWFviO4lUeyIC1DifFHshU9r9kyyRdx0n_yv1DQrUkXPh7KCXi18s5H7PpU2yH01FDlsK15UMdiYCV_r92cBjx14eAVYXv8yriEIuVC8PJFuTazYiGYydQFWmF5t9IEpVI2HCpXI0evg2G6yrrZUhukLUwCNe4FG7V8Y0ZauHEqg15cFYLsD5Y9BIYl65vTkAvNv0e8zEEukMkBopF5rq3XG1_Q_WQ/47y/BBBSPpuMTgOKB45ZnSfQtw/h2/h001.mXLjfqG3uMg0azOLkgV3x2u6vokFrH9x9Ay5x9rZYuA)
---
**_If you want to learn more about how we are going to win and defeat Donald Trump, please read on below._**
_**Where the Race Stands**_
While there is no question there is increased anxiety following the debate, we are not seeing this translate into a drastic shift in vote share. In fact, this morning, [a new ABC/Ipsos poll](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwobSM-TKMwDjYUaiVKYAwVbjSmdmuQ0p43nxM76JdWulO_JZCj3gbDwXF_Z8Woc_MUF7RO11oO6TvvDcib3Up75lVNJcrma1LDBiuqd9Ljm5SycWOSltFnKXgvd3tLE5TVwIxYdoGFQtADfehhdXOKcogcmDPeVReXp66L_z1G74gQrJNhyskx5N_qdutvUvd6SN34g3uzvFbbLjXKkCc-wdu-mS8CCoaMlrKhtJ91OUC6qhUs2WORPW7wlwIicMAKOi1jXw-Ta0ZdsNcs2jfato/47y/BBBSPpuMTgOKB45ZnSfQtw/h3/h001.BY8pddtzfK5Cfq0kXjunbynZC85oAVFlTDZFs3C-9O8) showed a tied race with no change since April.
Our internal data and public polling show the same thing: This remains a margin-of-error race in key battleground states.
**The movement we have seen, while real, is not a sea-change in the state of the race.** While some of this movement was from undecided voters to Trump, much of it was driven by voters who have always been our core persuasion targets. Our post-debate net favorability is 20 percentage points higher than Trump’s among these voters based on internal polling. That said, we believe we have a very real path to consolidating their support.
**Most importantly, we maintain multiple pathways to 270 electoral votes.** Right now, winning the Blue Wall states -- Michigan, Wisconsin, and Pennsylvania -- is the clearest pathway to that aim, but we also believe that the sunbelt states are not out of reach. The consensus across internal and public polling is that these states largely remain within the margin-of-error.
In addition to what we believe is a clear pathway ahead for us, there is also no indication that other Democratic candidates would outperform the President against Trump. Hypothetical polling of alternative nominees will always be unreliable, and surveys do not take into account the negative media environment that any Democratic nominee will encounter. **The only Democratic candidate for whom this is already baked in is President Biden.**
_There is a long way to go between now and Election Day with considerable uncertainty, but the data shows we have a clear path to win_. As we’ve always said, in today’s fragmented media environment, it will take time for our message to break through with trusted messengers and a strong ground game. That remains the case.
**_What Comes Next: Shoring Up the Biden-Harris Coalition_**
Our campaign remains laser-focused on battleground states and prioritizing outreach to the coalition that sent Joe Biden and Kamala Harris to the White House in 2020.
Last Friday, the President rallied over [1,000 fired-up supporters in Madison, Wisconsin](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.IrwCNRMzSkXvFsTjBP9k2BITomuAQoron_Cihm2_X6co-_mWFUxSferhE4J1yN28ni8J4z68r7BOyT-C_wQh-ljg6FbFTzSx6fDj-ad6QafByyhgnszrb2haAyfav6S-zdaTmeuvUe5VQhi0n4KJ5WiAXWsg0LgiaxoqHPG5RZchuySSlv0ZPAijgCorpi6jMLW4Ba6clgg7EDrdIo5rLbpfZIHWt5ptX_57_m_WukAVjrdspAWzdP0T1KyJgm6c/47y/BBBSPpuMTgOKB45ZnSfQtw/h4/h001.TOuvLnBINNQWLNNTNB0QWoDPAdaxAmA5sspGLkFX4Zs). On Sunday, he campaigned across Pennsylvania, [speaking at a church](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.IrwCNRMzSkXvFsTjBP9k2IJgJ0Yuj7OGXOUsxkN-JfdeVcBrVg5B2NS4N3GjeaTsg91cz1Xh8S3DJmqrpSt7MGCbyJMF3V-YU0ftwZrFZV_fKawa8jSfEjbxt5oMQ2NHXLJ4n_RsgAomuujtKZ9tNnX4kq2R3vmKzoN93P5uFBI0aYFeELvyd0UOpN8FNxifxWlknqvv4uvG8KLIGggJKTrn5tx598Atfi7jH2MXDnR4BoLBXMl0eSs9DvyH0CxQsv1fhKcdBxxpC9mjhOTREQ/47y/BBBSPpuMTgOKB45ZnSfQtw/h5/h001.u-IcjxyGw3V3bOsCX4miQ2z_lqRVO49jPoRNpoY-e74) in Northwest Philly, stopping by a field office with Senator Fetterman to fire up volunteers, talking with hundreds of supporters, including union members and local Democrats, at an [organizing event in Harrisburg](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.Khhv6i-A6kGAx4x-ts_8moUeBXe5T9PWXHqIRPrgcQleeFQz5A_hSN0A6xsKgTAnCVcerm0cN-oHyfimNmx_z-60_ktVB-ggHnDNNn8746mJGvyw5t-HhI8qRijdKBQMD7MhQ0c032ABhCa5J5-UxwdhmBY5b51TNSYOvev467MiRc74SVU6yVq-ZSiROnA0IETtew56fKbLn5uhGxNYpLYig1moK19FppOBt8Mvsvg/47y/BBBSPpuMTgOKB45ZnSfQtw/h6/h001.4Pq-W5e54b0oQVb9keb1hU09YI0do20IXp1D6uJXBnA), and grabbing coffee at a small business in Harrisburg with Governor Shapiro. And tomorrow, he’ll be in Detroit, Michigan.
The President has also spent the weeks following the debate rallying key constituencies that make up our winning coalition, meeting with Democratic governors and mayors from across the country, talking with key congressional leaders, meeting with labor leaders at the AFL-CIO yesterday, and more.
Next week, as Trump and extreme MAGA Republicans put their toxic extremism front and center at the Republican National Convention, the President will be [on the road](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwobSM-TKMwDjYUaiVKYAwVbg2YI91AgR9qvVjg_A5qlMiFcTLC1Rss50tKiIOFZ6RnNpzlEXR5oH1-r0zU8G3O45y7GpsYFv2TNRy4FycMZak_X733nQXYUJxNJrXc0HvsqrxXbKwFgmWzx4mECRtQNtifrlxP3xlg0PAOYwFxYa2GstdRdbib017TRbZT2C2UjjECpMVRSxycb8q4l1g4ORKoczQdpD8BMm4wZFDoyt4bjURmpHaQj8AMewg9G-VCaDuDRNsxLWFIs22VE8hvOHnbvWP7Am5LdCtLs59AHtfO3FLYnHbTYINAxbSWj3_oQ/47y/BBBSPpuMTgOKB45ZnSfQtw/h7/h001.r-Jh35xEqOwVHqo_LMNSohnp9kJjhBTz64rilK2_VpQ). On Monday, he will mark the 60th anniversary of the Civil Rights Act in Austin, Texas, followed by a trip to Las Vegas, Nevada for events with the NAACP, UNIDOS, and local leaders.
**_A Campaign Designed to Win Close Elections_**
**Our campaign has been designed to win a close election from the beginning.**
Since last fall, we have been building deep relationships in communities across the battleground states to register, persuade, mobilize, and turn out voters when it matters most. Using both in-person events and activities as well as engaging voters online, we are having conversations with voters to cut through media silos and political narratives.
At the same time, we made early and ongoing investments in a staff presence across the battleground states. We are presently at over 1,200 coordinated staff across key states. They are building an army of tens of thousands of volunteers who will talk to millions of voters. Meanwhile, Donald Trump’s operation relies almost exclusively on name ID and earned media, which presently Democrats are giving him in spades.
**_Framing the Election as a Choice_**
People are continuing to vote on the issues they care about -- which are also the very issues we are winning on. Many voters turned on the debate having forgotten how much they dislike Donald Trump. They left the debate with a fresh reminder of how extreme and dangerous a second Trump term would be.
With that in mind, our path centers on reminding voters that this election will be a choice between Joe Biden, who is fighting to move our country forward and make life better for working people, and Donald Trump, who is focused on his own revenge and retribution with no concern for who he hurts.
In our polling, we have seen that when we remind voters what Trump has done and said -- bragging about overturning _Roe v. Wade_ , saying that there has to be some form of punishment for women who have an abortion, proposing cuts to Social Security and Medicare and tax cuts for big corporations -- the voters who moved away from us after the debate came home. And, after hearing messaging about the stakes of the election, we move ahead of Trump in vote choice.
Our team has seized on this unique opportunity by amplifying Trump’s deeply unpopular agenda online and in ads. [Project 2025 is now more frequently searched than Taylor Swift and the NFL](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.SEgofQhSb9pGg8bz5XQG3cfylLbA_qAvMJtLFfyOZ0YeAgkTW0GaNljrm2fHU3IaOLEicfKDEVmiieyKx8MeVoNmAQPi3JOkIfNQlQbGdbuH3gHvEYTtWqav6gS7J5_Et6zZORi3W96BW4Mw_KKhxZXre13FMAEHA93HI14L8BeOWuazLKVjumWRutN8Pry3ZzMnOruzrJdt4Zvxrdynva-kF-o19Rc1q69OkXhlXQeQSqu5_PlBw4cFBhTwde103NkxE_q7U7_rNa6q2xy-fL8SYp1D3lclCrW2RJnBKSI/47y/BBBSPpuMTgOKB45ZnSfQtw/h8/h001.S5PFficMaYqb_SVLQzVbo_KmZ2x_XikzHzc6jj8I3PU), and President Biden himself weighed in, warning that Project 2025 _“would give Trump limitless power over our daily lives and let him use the presidency to enact ‘revenge’ on his enemies, ban abortion nationwide and punish women who have an abortion, and gut the checks and balances that make America the greatest democracy in the world. It’s extreme and dangerous.”_
When we reach our target voters with the President’s positive vision, they respond to it. This is not a simple task in this media environment, but it is a straightforward one. While we will aggressively attack the threat that Trump poses, we will simultaneously paint the picture of the America Joe Biden and Democrats nationwide are fighting for. One where we restore Roe, make billionaires pay their fair share in taxes, lower costs for American families, and protect our fundamental rights and freedoms.
During the 2022 midterms, Democrats were disciplined and banded together to expose Republicans up and down the ballot for their extremism on democracy and reproductive freedom, heading off a red wave the pundits said was inevitable. We have an opportunity to do that again over the next three and half months -- and there is no better time than next week to start.
**_The Bottom Line_**
No one is denying that the debate was a setback. But the President and this team have made it through setbacks before. We are clear eyed about what we need to do to win. And we will win by moving forward, unified as a party.
**We must focus on defeating Donald Trump every single day between now and Election Day. There’s never been a more important moment than right now to show that you are ready to defeat him once and for all. So, I have to ask:**

() Jen O’Malley Dillon here, Campaign Chair on Team Biden-Harris. In the wake of last month’s debate, many of you have asked for an update on the path ahead and what we need to do to work together to defeat Donald Trump. Going into the debate, our campaign was clear-eyed about the five things we needed to do to win this race: 1. Showing the strength of the President’s record of accomplishment, leadership, and support. 2. Going on the offense against Trump to draw contrast and show how dangerous another term would be. 3. Maintaining multiple pathways to 270 electoral votes, with a focus on the Blue Wall states. 4. Staying laser-focused on our coalition of voters and double-down on our grassroots support. 5. Driving a vision and ambitious agenda for the future. Those imperatives remain true. What has changed following the debate is the urgency and discipline with which we need to pursue them. We believe if we follow the roadmap below, we will win. So, I hope you’ll take a second to read it. | | | If you want to learn more about how we are going to win and defeat Donald Trump, please read on below. Where the Race Stands While there is no question there is increased anxiety following the debate, we are not seeing this translate into a drastic shift in vote share. In fact, this morning, showed a tied race with no change since April. Our internal data and public polling show the same thing: This remains a margin-of-error race in key battleground states. The movement we have seen, while real, is not a sea-change in the state of the race. While some of this movement was from undecided voters to Trump, much of it was driven by voters who have always been our core persuasion targets. Our post-debate net favorability is 20 percentage points higher than Trump’s among these voters based on internal polling. That said, we believe we have a very real path to consolidating their support. Most importantly, we maintain multiple pathways to 270 electoral votes. Right now, winning the Blue Wall states -- Michigan, Wisconsin, and Pennsylvania -- is the clearest pathway to that aim, but we also believe that the sunbelt states are not out of reach. The consensus across internal and public polling is that these states largely remain within the margin-of-error. In addition to what we believe is a clear pathway ahead for us, there is also no indication that other Democratic candidates would outperform the President against Trump. Hypothetical polling of alternative nominees will always be unreliable, and surveys do not take into account the negative media environment that any Democratic nominee will encounter. The only Democratic candidate for whom this is already baked in is President Biden. There is a long way to go between now and Election Day with considerable uncertainty, but the data shows we have a clear path to win. As we’ve always said, in today’s fragmented media environment, it will take time for our message to break through with trusted messengers and a strong ground game. That remains the case. What Comes Next: Shoring Up the Biden-Harris Coalition Our campaign remains laser-focused on battleground states and prioritizing outreach to the coalition that sent Joe Biden and Kamala Harris to the White House in 2020. Last Friday, the President rallied over . On Sunday, he campaigned across Pennsylvania, in Northwest Philly, stopping by a field office with Senator Fetterman to fire up volunteers, talking with hundreds of supporters, including union members and local Democrats, at an , and grabbing coffee at a small business in Harrisburg with Governor Shapiro. And tomorrow, he’ll be in Detroit, Michigan. The President has also spent the weeks following the debate rallying key constituencies that make up our winning coalition, meeting with Democratic governors and mayors from across the country, talking with key congressional leaders, meeting with labor leaders at the AFL-CIO yesterday, and more. Next week, as Trump and extreme MAGA Republicans put their toxic extremism front and center at the Republican National Convention, the President will be . On Monday, he will mark the 60th anniversary of the Civil Rights Act in Austin, Texas, followed by a trip to Las Vegas, Nevada for events with the NAACP, UNIDOS, and local leaders. A Campaign Designed to Win Close Elections Our campaign has been designed to win a close election from the beginning. Since last fall, we have been building deep relationships in communities across the battleground states to register, persuade, mobilize, and turn out voters when it matters most. Using both in-person events and activities as well as engaging voters online, we are having conversations with voters to cut through media silos and political narratives. At the same time, we made early and ongoing investments in a staff presence across the battleground states. We are presently at over 1,200 coordinated staff across key states. They are building an army of tens of thousands of volunteers who will talk to millions of voters. Meanwhile, Donald Trump’s operation relies almost exclusively on name ID and earned media, which presently Democrats are giving him in spades. Framing the Election as a Choice People are continuing to vote on the issues they care about -- which are also the very issues we are winning on. Many voters turned on the debate having forgotten how much they dislike Donald Trump. They left the debate with a fresh reminder of how extreme and dangerous a second Trump term would be. With that in mind, our path centers on reminding voters that this election will be a choice between Joe Biden, who is fighting to move our country forward and make life better for working people, and Donald Trump, who is focused on his own revenge and retribution with no concern for who he hurts. In our polling, we have seen that when we remind voters what Trump has done and said -- bragging about overturning Roe v. Wade , saying that there has to be some form of punishment for women who have an abortion, proposing cuts to Social Security and Medicare and tax cuts for big corporations -- the voters who moved away from us after the debate came home. And, after hearing messaging about the stakes of the election, we move ahead of Trump in vote choice. Our team has seized on this unique opportunity by amplifying Trump’s deeply unpopular agenda online and in ads. , and President Biden himself weighed in, warning that Project 2025 “would give Trump limitless power over our daily lives and let him use the presidency to enact ‘revenge’ on his enemies, ban abortion nationwide and punish women who have an abortion, and gut the checks and balances that make America the greatest democracy in the world. It’s extreme and dangerous.” When we reach our target voters with the President’s positive vision, they respond to it. This is not a simple task in this media environment, but it is a straightforward one. While we will aggressively attack the threat that Trump poses, we will simultaneously paint the picture of the America Joe Biden and Democrats nationwide are fighting for. One where we restore Roe, make billionaires pay their fair share in taxes, lower costs for American families, and protect our fundamental rights and freedoms. During the 2022 midterms, Democrats were disciplined and banded together to expose Republicans up and down the ballot for their extremism on democracy and reproductive freedom, heading off a red wave the pundits said was inevitable. We have an opportunity to do that again over the next three and half months -- and there is no better time than next week to start. The Bottom Line No one is denying that the debate was a setback. But the President and this team have made it through setbacks before. We are clear eyed about what we need to do to win. And we will win by moving forward, unified as a party. We must focus on defeating Donald Trump every single day between now and Election Day. There’s never been a more important moment than right now to show that you are ready to defeat him once and for all. So, I have to ask: If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | Thank you for your support, Jen Jen O'Malley Dillon Campaign Chair, Biden for President | | | ---|---|---

#
Derek, I’m not changing my mind. 🙄
Last night, I went on Fox News and spoke truth to power: **President Biden is our guy.**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240711?refcode=em20240711-9212&refcode2=9212_434096_baXWUL&akid=9212%2E434096%2EbaXWUL)
Joe Biden is old. Big whoop. No matter how many Democrats come out against our president, it won’t mean much when it comes to my support for Joe. _**He’s the best person for the job.**_
Look, I’m not following the President blindly here. Joe Biden has been a **great** President. During his term, Joe has:
* Lowered costs of families’ everyday expenses through the Inflation Reduction Act and 99 other actions 📉
* Created more jobs (nearly 11 million!) than any recent President – Republican or Democrat 💼
* Brought business back to the US through the CHIPS and Science Act 🏭
* Enacted historic student debt relief for middle- and working-class families 💸
* And the list goes on, Derek

👉 A reminder: **A bad debate is not the sum total of the person and their record.**
Based on his record, Joe Biden is exactly what this country needs. Your support right now will ensure he can continue delivering the success we have seen over the past four years.
**[Derek, will you join me in aggressively supporting Joe’s campaign for re-election through a $5 donation?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240711?refcode=em20240711-9212&refcode2=9212_434096_baXWUL&akid=9212%2E434096%2EbaXWUL)**

While Democrats dream up make-believe replacements, Republicans are fighting hard to elect a convicted felon to office and enact the most restrictive agenda known to man **(seriously, Google Project 2025).**
I’ll be the one to say it: **Their priorities are wrong.**
It’s time we put this discussion to rest: **President Biden beat Donald Trump four years ago + he’s going to do it again. 💪**
**[Derek, now more than ever, we need to stand with President Biden. Will you give $5 to his campaign right now to help defeat Donald Trump and deliver real results for the American people?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240711?refcode=em20240711-9212&refcode2=9212_434096_baXWUL&akid=9212%2E434096%2EbaXWUL)**

I really believe loyalty is one of the last currencies in this lousy business. It’s time Democrats showed some to Joe and Kamala.
❤️ John

U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania

[ https://act.hillharper.com/go/422?t=1001&akid=1295%2E62735%2EHvIWF5 ]Hill Harper for Senate

Hi there — I’m Marilyn Harper, Hill’s mother!

[ https://act.hillharper.com/go/1229?t=1002&akid=1295%2E62735%2EHvIWF5 ]Marilyn and Hill Harper, hugging.

Peter, I was
immensely proud of Hill when he told me he was running to represent
Michigan in the U.S. Senate.

Ever since he was a boy, he’s had a passion for service to others — and
I've watched him carry those values with him throughout his life. Harry
and I raised him to be compassionate, loving, and empathetic. We raised
him to make life better for the people around him, and I know deep in
my heart it’s the reason he jumped into this Senate race.

Hill has what it takes because he’s always been a fighter — whether in
law school, during his battle with cancer, or as a single father
looking after his mother and young son under one roof.

But Hill is facing some tough odds, and while I’m his biggest
cheerleader, it’s going to take a lot more than a mother’s love and
support to get him across the finish line. [ https://act.hillharper.com/go/1903?t=1003&akid=1295%2E62735%2EHvIWF5 ]If you could chip in just
$5, $10, or even $25, I know it will go a long way in helping him build
the campaign he needs to win.

DONATE »

Thank you so much,
Peter. Let’s help Hill make us
all proud!

Dr. Marilyn Harper

Fellow American,

Thank you for opening this email. In a world where political noise drowns out the voices of hard working Americans like us, **your attention means everything.**

**Did you know that only a fraction of supporters open these emails, and even fewer take action?** Yet, it's individuals like you and me, who understand the challenges our communities face who hold the power to make a difference.

Please read this email through to the end. Your engagement could be the difference-maker. And if, after reading, you're unable to contribute, know that your support in spirit is equally valued.

I'm committed to ensuring that everyday Americans like us fuel our conservative values.

**[Imagine the impact if everyone who opened this email donated just $1](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=7fed71b2a84c47f3a675f0550ce61326&_e=_h7GEfIxVSVQgfhctKCV-5S_Mh2_F5l3o3Q_3SL3RBtAsPeH2o0p21mfNbdKhEjMdCMVYGnqgdt6VTjzSB_uIHplpVisXBVHafeXKFoiCdJbn7YMI4L5kJ4B2SeuCVUvY9Zd-jiW4BMPIc5r2EXZPK13W-hfXKqop8QEUDzMu0sTtUfLoQWy1XW8TIZYAv1hUsR4eme8fKmqk5xh9_u0dZbqrb1OBSiLegPi6uEiFccAB7hvZbxl6uOj5ktKf9wwq__RTiH_-UWYj51uCfataI9jFPN_ByjuLo_YuFqKnbHwXza8zszLqG-Xed2SYcyjIvzddCnhVwZB7zngxklMbajfZYrVBJH9IE1DjYjksuxIvN2wpeJWwT05XS6WXr73FypkGMnLqOnyv2tPLhaTWOU7OgBjNVeytWOCuC6z5Is%3D)** – a single dollar. With your support, we can surpass all of our goals and make a real difference.

I've witnessed the decline of American manufacturing and the struggles of hardworking families like mine. Despite the challenges, my grandmother, **Mamaw** , was my rock, guiding me with her tough love and unwavering faith.

Mamaw's tough love and unwavering faith shaped my character, instilling values of hard work, perseverance, and family. # Do you support VOTER ID laws?
### You must show a ID when you go to vote!!
| | | [Dan Carr](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)

I strongly support voter ID requirements when it comes to voting!! Ensuring that voters present identification and prove their registration status is essential to maintaining the integrity of our elections. This measure helps prevent fraud, verifies voter eligibility, and reinforces the principle that voting is both a fundamental right and a serious responsibility. Implementing and enforcing voter ID laws is a necessary step to protect our democracy and ensure every legitimate vote counts.

Don’t believe the pundits or the polls. **The 2024 Election could be the closest in a century!** And we can’t afford to allow non-citizens to cast the deciding vote. That’s why the conservative team at Heritage Action is making a MASSIVE push to pass the Save Act through the Senate and BAN non-citizens from voting. The International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers endorsed me to represent Maryland’s Third Congressional District! = As the granddaughter of an IBEW electrical worker, I’m proud to have worked with IBEW over my years in the Maryland Senate to pass legislation to ensure investments in clean energy jobs and tear down the barriers that prevent people from fully participating in our economy. This past session, we worked together to pass the Brighter Tomorrow Act to drastically expand solar energy production – a testament to our shared values of creating family-sustaining jobs that generate clean, renewable energy. In Congress, I will be just as committed to the urgent fight to speed up our transition to clean energy. I spent my childhood in Middletown, Ohio, in a working-class family. I didn't have all the glamor that most people in politics have growing up; let me tell you, there were no silver spoons in our household.

I was raised by my Mamaw and Papaw, and they taught me the nobility of hard work.

In my hometown, I saw my friend's parents hard at work in the factories. These same manufacturing jobs are now in danger of being ripped from our grasp because of China and bad trade deals absolutely destroying the manufacturing sector.

Washington Elites have failed at protecting most Americans. Career politicians are focused on big dollar donors, focused on pleasing their friends, and pushing their own swampy agendas. **They 've never cared about taxing your small businesses, protecting your rights, or preventing the crises facing middle America. **

This is why I knew I had to run for office. I was determined to stand up to this record of failure and fight for working Americans. I'm looking out for the Americans like the ones I grew up with, the ones left behind by those who promised to look out for them.

It's the honor of a lifetime to serve this great country and the Buckeye State, but I can't keep doing it without your support.

clean_body: I haven't told you this in a while | Hi Peter, I haven 't introduced myself in a while, and I want you to know why I believe what I do. I spent my childhood in Middletown, Ohio, in a working-class family. I didn't have all the glamor that most people in politics have growing up; let me tell you, there were no silver spoons in our household. I was raised by my Mamaw and Papaw, and they taught me the nobility of hard work. In my hometown, I saw my friend's parents hard at work in the factories. These same manufacturing jobs are now in danger of being ripped from our grasp because of China and bad trade deals absolutely destroying the manufacturing sector. Washington Elites have failed at protecting most Americans. Career politicians are focused on big dollar donors, focused on pleasing their friends, and pushing their own swampy agendas. They 've never cared about taxing your small businesses, protecting your rights, or preventing the crises facing middle America. This is why I knew I had to run for office. I was determined to stand up to this record of failure and fight for working Americans. I'm looking out for the Americans like the ones I grew up with, the ones left behind by those who promised to look out for them. It's the honor of a lifetime to serve this great country and the Buckeye State, but I can't keep doing it without your support. | Thank you, JD Vance Conservative Outsider. Marine. Businessman. Author. Ohio needs a true conservative in the U.S. Senate. It needs someone who understands how our economic and government leaders conspire to make life harder for normal Americans. name: Carole King
subject: Did you know that our democracy is on the line this November?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BOB CASEY FOR SENATE INC
body:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240711-3?recurring=1&refcode=em20240711-3&refcode2=3539_552475_sTK6uU&akid=3539%2E552475%2EsTK6uU)
Hi Peter, it’s Carole King 🎶 and I personally wrote this email.
**Bob Casey is running for re-election to the U.S. Senate so he can continue to fight for our rights and freedoms and laws that lift and protect families.**
His opponent is a Connecticut billionaire who wants to add the title Senator to his name.
[**If you agree that Bob should continue his work in the U.S. Senate, please donate $5 right now and have a great rest of your day!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240711-3?recurring=1&refcode=em20240711-3&refcode2=3539_552475_sTK6uU&akid=3539%2E552475%2EsTK6uU)
**Did you know that our democracy is on the line this November?** Bob Casey respects our democracy and the rule of law. He believes it’s important to hold elected officials accountable and maintain the soul of our nation.
We need Bob in the Senate to protect voting rights, women’s rights, and workers’ rights and continue to solve problems for you and your family. His opponent won’t do that.
[**With so much at stake in this election, your donation will help educate and motivate more voters who share our values. That’s why I’m asking you to give $5 or whatever you can afford today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240711-3?recurring=1&refcode=em20240711-3&refcode2=3539_552475_sTK6uU&akid=3539%2E552475%2EsTK6uU)
Bob’s opponent would lower taxes for billionaires and gut essential programs like Medicare, Medicaid, and Social Security. He doesn’t care about seniors who would be forced to use pill cutters to extend the time before they need to refill a prescription.
**Bob Casey cares. Will you join me in contributing $5 or whatever you can afford to keep him in the U.S. Senate?**
_Please use the links in this email to start a monthly donation through ActBlue._
[Donate $15 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240711-3?recurring=1&amount=15&refcode=em20240711-3-el&refcode2=3539_552475_sTK6uU&akid=3539%2E552475%2EsTK6uU) [Donate $25 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240711-3?recurring=1&amount=25&refcode=em20240711-3-el&refcode2=3539_552475_sTK6uU&akid=3539%2E552475%2EsTK6uU) [Donate $50 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240711-3?recurring=1&amount=50&refcode=em20240711-3-el&refcode2=3539_552475_sTK6uU&akid=3539%2E552475%2EsTK6uU) [Donate $100 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240711-3?recurring=1&amount=100&refcode=em20240711-3-el&refcode2=3539_552475_sTK6uU&akid=3539%2E552475%2EsTK6uU) [Donate $250 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240711-3?recurring=1&amount=250&refcode=em20240711-3-el&refcode2=3539_552475_sTK6uU&akid=3539%2E552475%2EsTK6uU) [Other amount »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240711-3?recurring=1&refcode=em20240711-3&refcode2=3539_552475_sTK6uU&akid=3539%2E552475%2EsTK6uU)

Peter, MAGA may be loud, but they’re static. There are more of _us_ , and our movement is growing. Our small donations add up to [**grassroots power**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240711-3?recurring=1&refcode=em20240711-3&refcode2=3539_552475_sTK6uU&akid=3539%2E552475%2EsTK6uU). If we all contribute in whatever ways we can, we can WIN.
Thank you so much for participating. My very best wishes to you and your family,
— Carole
_Carole King is a singer-songwriter, author, and activist. Now Carole is using her platform to help elect an expanded Democratic Senate majority. And she really did write this email._

Dear friend,
I want to take a minute to personally thank each of you for your support in my campaign. Your support helps me get out my "Proven and Tested" message out and I can't thank you enough.

When I write these weekly emails, it reminds me of the reason I am running for Congress...to make our country better for you and our families. It's why I get up everyday and fight the good fight. And I will never quit.

|

**VOTE AUGUST 20TH**
The countdown to Election Day is on, and we're fired up and ready to win! ** ** **Only 50 days to go until the primary election on August 20th!**
[](https://link.support.mike4congress.)
Make sure you're prepared by finding your polling location at the link**[here](https://link.support.mike4congress.)**.

Every vote is a step toward securing a brighter future for our nation.

Let's rally together, fight for our Conservative values, and Make America Great Again!

|

_Looking for ways to get involved?_
Whether it's placing a yard sign in your front yard, knocking on doors, waving signs, or attending events, we need your help!
**[Sign up to join our team on our website>>](https://link.support.mike4congress.)**

Mike Haridopolos

Rocio, one of our wonderful volunteers in Tarrant County, just texted me
this beautiful story, and I wanted to share it with you.

Pauline first volunteered with me at Dream Park. She wasn’t a VDR back
then but was eager to do her part in registering voters.

She wore a shirt with a photo of a Poll Tax Receipt. When I asked her
about it, she said, “It was my father’s. He died 13 years ago. I have the
same for my mother, who died 2 years ago at age 93. Regardless of how
little finances they had, they always paid [their Poll Tax] to vote.”

Yesterday, Pauline registered her first voters as a new VDR at Tarrant
County Community College.

Pauline reminds us that we have a democracy because of those who came
before us, who were willing to persevere through indignity, fight against
injustice and win voting rights for all Americans. These rights are now
under attack unlike any other time in our history.

That’s why we have to follow her example and do the work to save this
democracy for the generations that follow ours.

Aloha Peter, Did you know that 8 is my lucky number? [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88726297/484933362/-1699377675?refcode=AU_MKH_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240711_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTRjODUyZS1kNTNmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QPmsyb5ChKoyqhApNg71vcZoLGAc5UIR_0rl-zuYw48=) My husband, Leighton, and I chose August 8, 1989 as our wedding date, in hopes that the lucky repetition of 8s would bestow good fortune to us _(and make it easier to remember our anniversary! Otherwise, one could easily forget.)_ I know it is easy to despair with everything that is at stake in this election. It has been a tough few weeks. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88726967/484935597/820848947?refcode=AU_JC_FR_TAN_GEN_AC30_20240711_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZjM0OWNiZS1kODNmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Qbkg356LxF4-ZHSeu1OknwEtXXHtclQhSqgoNEu-iF0=) Thanks to my family, my community, and a lot of hard work, I got into college. But before I graduated, I enlisted in the Marines to serve the country that gave me so much. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88726968/484935598/820848947?refcode=AU_JC_FR_TAN_GEN_AC30_20240711_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZjM0OWNiZS1kODNmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Qbkg356LxF4-ZHSeu1OknwEtXXHtclQhSqgoNEu-iF0=) I deployed to Al Anbar, Iraq with my brothers in arms. They called us “Lucky Lima”, but our luck turned eventually. We ended up the hardest Marine hit unit of the entire Iraq war, and I lost some of my best friends over there. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88726969/484935599/820848947?refcode=AU_JC_FR_TAN_GEN_AC30_20240711_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZjM0OWNiZS1kODNmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Qbkg356LxF4-ZHSeu1OknwEtXXHtclQhSqgoNEu-iF0=) You’re never the same person after something like that. And I knew I had to do something to improve things for the guys I served with, for people who grew up like me. So, I ended up running for Congress — and I won. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88726970/484935600/820848947?refcode=AU_JC_FR_TAN_GEN_AC30_20240711_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZjM0OWNiZS1kODNmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Qbkg356LxF4-ZHSeu1OknwEtXXHtclQhSqgoNEu-iF0=) Then, on January 6th, everything changed. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88726971/484935601/820848947?refcode=AU_JC_FR_TAN_GEN_AC30_20240711_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZjM0OWNiZS1kODNmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Qbkg356LxF4-ZHSeu1OknwEtXXHtclQhSqgoNEu-iF0=) So now, I’m running for U.S. Senate. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88726972/484935602/820848947?refcode=AU_JC_FR_TAN_GEN_AC30_20240711_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZjM0OWNiZS1kODNmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Qbkg356LxF4-ZHSeu1OknwEtXXHtclQhSqgoNEu-iF0=) Back when I was that kid sleeping on the floor of our apartment, I never would’ve guessed this is how things would turn out. Since the Sudanese Civil War began in April 2024, the world has witnessed one of the gravest--and most ignored--humanitarian catastrophes. One article will not by any means do it justice, however, I am hopeful that you will use this information to help play a productive role in supporting those suffering and encouraging an end to this atrocity.
So, **Let 's Address This.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/45f4d508-0854-477b-967f-b110caf93ff0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

## What started the war?
A Sudanese run community platform, [NasAlSudan](https://substack.com/redirect/baf7e856-98a7-4abb-bf34-cd7973ae0db6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), is an excellent source of accurate insight on Sudan. I provide below the content they've pushed out across social media. I highly encourage you to follow them on social media above and continue to elevate their content.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e0467931-59e3-4a8e-9317-ef105cd25a3f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
## What is the current status of the war?
With each passing day the conflict grows more unstable. As NPR reports citing [UNICEF](https://substack.com/redirect/4ab671e9-5e88-4df9-9ae5-af51464a5517?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> According to UNICEF, at least 77 hospitals across Sudan have come under attack since the war began. Aid groups say that with the extreme fighting that's resulted in the displacement of more than 7 million people, Sudan has become the [largest humanitarian crisis in the world](https://substack.com/redirect/1de11404-f603-4d40-9051-dfecb8366427?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and that the attacks have made it difficult for health workers to respond and provide critical medical services to millions of people.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c191afab-01e3-4f83-a07a-e6172e86d8f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
## How can we help?
NasAlSudan created this helpful graphic on the three areas we can each support the people of Sudan. Deepen your knowledge about Sudan (by listening to Sudanese scholars [like Guardian columnist Nesrine Malik](https://substack.com/redirect/d8855ba5-e2c2-4bdd-8e12-c95a421df7e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), donate to grassroots organizations on the ground like the [Sudan UN fund ](https://substack.com/redirect/1d04893d-d8ac-4e13-a1e7-e34978901ae3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)that is exclusively focused on the people of Sudan, and [write to your member of Congress ](https://substack.com/redirect/31d5fc50-965b-462e-976e-2e8bcb869169?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)to demand action and peace.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b8053361-f96f-4ed8-b806-96fdc1f52063?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Tens of millions of innocent people continue to suffer horrific atrocity in Sudan. It is critical we use our platforms to raise awareness and understanding, and most importantly, action to encourage peace and justice. Please share this content by NasAlSudan, and continue to raise your voice for justice for the people of Sudan.

Uncover RFK Jr.'s strategies for financial literacy and combating inflation Is there an alternative approach to reparations? Examine RFK Jr.'s community-focused approach to addressing historical injustices And more! Let's begin. Common Sense Weekly Welcome back! In this edition: Is education reform the key to addressing racial disparities? Unpack RFK Jr.'s proposals What is RFK Jr.'s vision for America's economic future? Uncover RFK Jr.'s strategies for financial literacy and combating inflation Is there an alternative approach to reparations? Examine RFK Jr.'s community-focused approach to addressing historical injustices And more! Let's begin. Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s presidential campaign has forged a partnership with the Libertarian Party of Colorado, securing a spot on the state ballot for the 2024 election. This alliance aims to challenge the two-party system and offer voters a fresh alternative. The campaign plans to collaborate with the Libertarian Party of Colorado on various voter engagement activities, including canvassing and phone banking. | | | ---|--- | []() | mailto:?subject=Check this out&body=Take a look at this: RFK Jr. Secures Historic Colorado Ballot Access Through Libertarian Alliance . Found it on Common Sense Weekly \(Subscribe here: \.) ---|--- | []() | ---|--- RFK Jr.'s presidential run could establish a new political party in New York State, named "We The People ", The New York State Board of Elections has stipulated that if RFK Jr. achieves either 2% of the total votes cast or 130,000 votes, whichever is higher, the party would gain official status and ballot access for two years. This opportunity arises from recent changes to New York's election laws, which have made it more challenging for minor parties to maintain ballot lines. | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- | Shape Tomorrow with RFK Jr: Your Voice, Your Vote Contribute to a brighter future through action:🗳️ Secure ballot access for RFK Jr across the nation.💡 Volunteer for a campaign that represents your values.🌍 Build a more inclusive, united future together.🤝 Join forces with fellow advocates in your community.🎉 Be part of a movement that fights for all Americans. | | | Robert F. Kennedy Jr. addresses the persistent challenges confronting Black Americans, focusing on education and criminal justice. He points out that despite an annual $50 billion investment in education, the quality of schooling for Black children has declined. He advocates for alternative models like school choice and charter schools to address these educational disparities.The discussion then shifts to the mass incarceration crisis disproportionately affecting Black communities. RFK Jr. highlights the high rate of contact between Black men and correctional services, with non-violent drug offenses as a primary driver of imprisonment. He identifies specific legislation as contributing factors to this ongoing issue. | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- | Don't miss your chance to make a difference! Own a Piece of the American Dream at the Red, White, & Independent Auction Take home a piece of history and support the Robert F. Kennedy Jr. campaign at the Red, White, & Independent Auction!This isn't your ordinary auction. We're talking exclusive items that embody the very essence of American pride and independence. Every purchase celebrates the values we hold dear and fuels the fight for a better tomorrow. | | | Rick Clark, a fifth-generation farmer from Indiana, sits down with RFK Jr. to share his successful transition from conventional to regenerative farming practices on his 7,000-acre farm. He emphasizes the impact of farming practices on both human health and the environment, advocating for a transition towards organic and no-till methods, and reiterates the role of government subsidies in regenerative agriculture success.Key points: Regenerative methods improve soil health, water infiltration, and biodiversity Economic benefits of regenerative farming include higher ROI and reduced input costs * Tiered government subsidies can promote regenerative practices | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- At Latino Wall Street, RFK Jr. shares his vision for America's economic future, focusing on the importance of financial literacy, education, and supportive economic policies. He also addresses the pressing issue of inflation, linking it to excessive government spending and the "war machine." He then outlines his plan to combat these economic challenges, which includes reducing government expenditures and promoting fiscal responsibility.Throughout the conversation, he expresses his desire to be remembered for restoring hope and pride in America, underlining his commitment to strengthening the middle class and creating opportunities for financial stability and growth. | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- RFK Jr. and 19Keys examine the complex issue of slavery reparations, discussing its constitutional basis and implementation challenges. They compare it to Japanese American reparations and focus on the difficulties in securing congressional funding, even for quantifiable injustices.Recognizing these obstacles, RFK Jr. proposes an alternative approach focusing on targeted community repair. His strategy involves transferring capital directly to affected communities, empowering them to lead their own rebuilding efforts. | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- Independent Presidential Candidate Robert F. | | Caroleene Dobson is a distinguished attorney, wife, mother, District Two resident, and a lifelong advocate for conservative values. Born and raised in Beatrice, Alabama, Dobson grew up on her family's fifth-generation cattle farm, where she learned the meaning of hard work and developed a firsthand understanding of the challenges faced by hardworking families and entrepreneurs. Currently practicing real estate law at the Maynard Nexsen law firm, Dobson represents a diverse clientele, including homebuilders, retailers, small business owners, and private landowners. She has spent her career advocating for her client’s interests while also achieving tangible, positive outcomes. In Congress, she will hold true to her core conservative values while ensuring Washington D.C. is working for the people of District Two. A passionate advocate for families, farms, and faith, Dobson aims to preserve the bedrock values and moral backbone that have defined our nation. With a call for Alabama common sense, she is determined to challenge the far-left agenda in Washington, D.C., advocating for the rights of property owners and defending the freedom to think, speak, and act without interference. Caroleene, alongside her husband Bobby, is the proud parent of two daughters, Philippa and Lydia.
